title: Virtual Assistant – Client Success & Operations (GoHighLevel/CRM, Client Support, Reporting)
description:
ABOUT US



The Review Pals helps UK businesses get more Google reviews automatically. We run review request campaigns, manage client accounts inside GoHighLevel, and handle everything from onboarding to reporting so business owners don't have to think about it. We're a small, fast-moving team and we treat clients like people, not tickets



We're hiring a Virtual Assistant to become the engine room behind our client accounts someone who can run our systems, keep clients happy, and flag problems before we even notice them.



===================================

PART 1: WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

===================================



This role is largely work that follows clear SOPs (we'll give you written steps and Loom videos for almost everything) but it also needs someone who pays attention, not just someone who follows steps blindly



Client Account Setup & Delivery:

- Create and configure new client sub-accounts in GoHighLevel (HighLevel)

- Set up and monitor regulatory bundles (A2P/10DLC-type compliance for SMS)

- Set up standard Zaps in Zapier for new clients

- Build and manage integrations with client CRMs, booking systems, and invoicing systems

- Track review request progress and results per client

- Chase up "non-integrated" clients who haven't sent over their data yet



Client Onboarding:

- Pre-onboarding prep (getting accounts and data ready before a client goes live)

- Post-onboarding setup and first-week checks



Client Communication & Support:

- Handle day-to-day client support via
 and text

- Send monthly update
s to clients

- Flag and communicate "wins" (e.g. a client hits a certain number of new reviews)

- Reach out to clients for video testimonials

- Reach out to clients for Google reviews where needed

- Be the calm, clear point of contact when something needs fixing



Reporting:

- Send an End of Day report

- Send a Weekly report

- Run weekly client check-ins and send clients their own progress reports



Content & Creative:

- Edit and trim video testimonials in Kapwing

- Create simple graphics/social content in Canva

- Update content on the website, Google Business Profile, and social channels



Problem-Solving:

- Recognise when a client's reviews are coming in slowly and apply known fixes

- Follow up proactively on stalled integrations

- Flag anything unusual — a proactive, "notice it before I have to ask" mindset matters more here than in a typical admin role



Tools you'll be working in daily: GoHighLevel, Trello, Notion, Slack, Zapier, Canva, Kapwing.



===================================

PART 2: WHAT YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW / HAVE

===================================



- Strong written English — client
s and texts represent our brand directly

- Comfortable learning new software quickly 

- Experience with at least a few of: GoHighLevel, Trello, Notion, Slack, Zapier, Canva

- Basic video editing exposure (Kapwing, CapCut, or similar) — doesn't need to be advanced

- Reliable internet, a quiet place to work, and the discipline to hit daily/weekly reporting deadlines without being chased

- Genuinely proactive — able to spot "this client hasn't sent data in 5 days" or "this client's reviews have stalled" without being told to check

- Comfortable with client-facing communication (not just internal admin)



Nice to have (not required):

- Prior experience in a GoHighLevel agency, marketing agency, or reputation management company

- Experience with Google Business Profile management

- Experience writing or following SOPs

HOW TO APPLY

===================================



The first 2–4 weeks will be a paid trial period for both of us to make sure it's the right fit

1. Your experience with GoHighLevel, Trello, Notion, Slack, or Zapier (name which ones and how you used them)

3. A link to any video editing or Canva work you've done, if you have it

   - Your name and where you're based

We are a plumbing company based in Sydney, Australia.

We service residential, commercial and property-management clients and are looking to build a much stronger online presence across Sydney.



We operate in a very competitive plumbing market, so we are looking for someone experienced who can help us grow properly over the long term.



This is not a basic SEO assistant role.

We want someone who can take ownership of our digital growth, think strategically, and tell us what we should be doing next.



Main responsibilities



* Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation

* Keyword research and competitor analysis

* Build and optimise service pages and suburb landing pages

* Rebuild and manage our website in WordPress

* Technical SEO, on-page SEO and internal linking

* Citations and quality backlink outreach

* Google Ads setup, management and ongoing optimisation

* Dedicated landing pages for Google Ads

* GA4, Google Tag Manager and Search Console

* Conversion tracking for calls and form enquiries

* CRM and marketing automation understanding

* Review and reputation strategy

* Website conversion-rate optimisation

* Strong Local SEO experience

* Proven Google Ads experience

* Strong WordPress skills

* Experience with service-area businesses

* Experience with plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing or other home-service businesses is highly preferred

* Good understanding of Google Business Profile

* Experience with tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4, GTM and Search Console

* Strong written English

* Able to work independently and make recommendations



What we want from the right person

We want someone who can look at our business, our competitors and the Sydney market and build a proper strategy around SEO, Google Maps, Google Ads, website structure and lead generation.



We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions or publishes generic AI content.



We want someone who can help us compete with larger Sydney plumbing/home-service companies and grow with the business long term.



Hours

Initially 20 hours per week / approximately 4 hours per day, with the opportunity to move into a full-time long-term role if the fit and results are strong.

We are an Australian technology start-up developing a new digital platform in the transport and mobility sector. We are looking for a talented part-time Full-Stack App Developer with strong AI development experience to join us as we prepare the platform for market launch.



The product is already well advanced and has a substantial working codebase and production infrastructure. This is not a greenfield project. You will work with an existing system, understand its architecture and help us complete, strengthen and expand the platform.



A major focus of the next development phase will be AI-powered voice functionality and intelligent agents, alongside continued development of our web, mobile and backend applications.



What You’ll Work On



Continue development of existing customer, driver and administration applications.

Build and integrate voice-command and conversational AI functionality.

Develop AI agents that can securely interact with application functions, APIs and backend services.

Work across frontend, backend, mobile applications and production infrastructure.

Integrate and maintain third-party APIs and services.

Debug, test and improve existing functionality.

Take features from concept through development, testing and production deployment.

Use modern AI development tools to accelerate development while maintaining high standards for security, reliability and code quality.



What We’re Looking For



Strong full-stack software development experience.

Strong TypeScript/JavaScript, React/Next.js and Node.js experience.

Mobile application development experience; React Native/Expo is highly desirable.

Experience with REST APIs, PostgreSQL/databases and cloud-hosted applications.

Genuine hands-on experience integrating LLMs and AI APIs into production applications.

Experience building AI agents, tool/function calling, automated workflows or conversational AI systems.

Experience with voice AI, speech-to-text, text-to-speech or real-time conversational systems is highly desirable.

Strong experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent.

Experience with platforms such as Stripe, Google Maps, Supabase, Twilio, Vercel or similar is advantageous.

Strong Git/GitHub and CI/CD experience.

Ability to understand and safely extend an existing production codebase rather than unnecessarily rebuilding working systems.

Strong attention to security, privacy, testing and production reliability.



Who We’re Looking For



We want someone who can take ownership, solve problems independently and communicate clearly. You should be comfortable working directly with the founder in a fast-moving start-up environment.



Importantly, we are looking for someone who understands how to use AI as an engineering accelerator, not as a replacement for sound software-engineering judgement.



The Opportunity



This is initially a part-time position with an early-stage Australian start-up approaching market launch.



For the right person, there is genuine potential for this position to develop into a long-term and potentially full-time role as the business grows.



You will be joining at an early stage, meaning the successful candidate will have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the technology and future direction of the product.



When Applying

This is not a traditional administrative role where you’ll simply be given a checklist of repetitive tasks. We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of the day-to-day details that come with running a fast-growing company and a busy schedule.



You’ll help manage everything from calendars, travel, appointments, and personal logistics to vendor follow-ups, research, documentation, recruiting coordination, and miscellaneous business administration.



The right person is proactive, persistent, discreet, and exceptionally good at figuring things out. You should be comfortable receiving a request like “Can you handle this?” and independently determining the steps needed to get it done.



What You’ll Own



Executive & Calendar Support



- Manage and organize the CEO’s calendar

- Schedule, reschedule, and coordinate meetings

- Protect focus time and help prioritize scheduling requests

- Coordinate interviews, vendor meetings, internal calls, and external appointments

- Make sure meeting links, documents, addresses, and relevant information are organized ahead of time

- Maintain reminders for important deadlines, renewals, appointments, and follow-ups

- Help maintain an organized running list of outstanding priorities and tasks



Travel & Reservations



- Research and book flights, hotels, transportation, and other travel

- Manage itineraries, confirmations, seat selections, check-ins, and reservation details

- Make restaurant and event reservations

- Coordinate travel changes, cancellations, refunds, and credits when necessary

- Create organized itineraries containing everything needed for a trip



Business Administration



- Follow up with vendors, suppliers, agencies, contractors, and other partners

- Track outstanding requests and make sure nothing falls through the cracks

- Request invoices, receipts, contracts, W-9s, insurance certificates, licenses, and other documentation

- Organize business documents, contracts, invoices, and records

- Help track invoices, payments, renewals, subscriptions, and recurring expenses

- Contact software companies, service providers, shipping carriers, banks, or other businesses to resolve administrative issues

- Maintain trackers and spreadsheets as needed

- Pull basic reports or exports from company platforms

- Organize information and research before decisions or meetings

- Assist with basic vendor sourcing and quote collection

- Track deliveries, samples, shipments, and other outstanding business items

- Help coordinate office, studio, and company logistics



Recruiting & Team Administration



- Coordinate candidate interviews and scheduling

- Send questionnaires, interview information, and follow-ups

- Maintain candidate trackers

- Assist with contractor and employee onboarding logistics

- Organize agreements, onboarding documents, and account-access requests

- Keep track of important contractor information, start dates, and documentation



Personal & Life Administration



- Book and manage appointments

- Handle personal reservations and scheduling

- Communicate with service providers on the CEO’s behalf

- Make phone calls to resolve account, billing, reservation, or service issues

- Coordinate returns, exchanges, refunds, deliveries, and appointments

- Research and purchase products or services when requested

- Help coordinate household, apartment, wedding, and other personal logistics

- Handle miscellaneous life-admin tasks that would otherwise take time away from the CEO



What We’re Looking For



2–4 years of previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or in a similar high-trust administrative support role. Experience directly supporting a founder, executive, or business owner strongly preferred.



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong phone communication skills and confidence speaking with US-based companies

- Extremely organized and detail-oriented

- Strong follow-through and persistence

- Resourceful and comfortable figuring things out independently

- Able to manage multiple open tasks without losing track of them

- Good judgment and ability to understand when something requires escalation

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly

- High level of discretion and professionalism

- Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new software

- Strong research and problem-solving skills

- Able to communicate clearly and concisely

- Proactive rather than waiting to be told every next step



Tools You May Work With



Experience with every platform is not required, but you should be comfortable learning tools such as:



- Gmail

- Google Calendar

- Google Drive

- Claude / ChatGPT

- Notion

- Slack

- Shopify

- Gusto

- Ramp

- Dropbox

- Excel / Google Sheets

- Travel and booking platforms



What Success Looks Like



You make the CEO’s life easier.



You keep track of the small things before they become big things. You follow up without being reminded. You know what is still outstanding, who owes us an answer, what deadline is approaching, and what needs attention.



When given a problem, your instinct is to investigate it, make the calls, send the
s, and come back with a solution.



Over time, the goal is for the CEO to be able to send you a message saying, “Can you handle this?” and trust that it will be handled from start to finish.

If this role sounds like a strong fit, please complete our application questionnaire below.



We review applications based on experience, communication, resourcefulness, and overall fit for the role.

title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Video Creator & Virtual Assistant
description:
AI TikTok Shop Affiliate Video Creator & Virtual Assistant — salary is negotiable 



I’m seeking a creative, dependable virtual assistant to produce polished TikTok Shop affiliate videos using product links, listing photos, seller-provided media and AI-powered tools.



No physical products will be shipped. You must be comfortable creating original, professional product videos entirely from the digital information and assets provided. This role is ideal for someone who understands short-form content, can develop compelling product angles and takes pride in delivering accurate, engaging work.



This is a part-time, long-term opportunity with flexible scheduling and the potential to grow into additional hours, performance bonuses and higher compensation as your quality, efficiency, reliability and results are demonstrated.



What You Will Do



* Research each product and its target customer

* Study current TikTok trends and successful product-video structures

* Develop original video concepts and selling angles

* Write attention-grabbing hooks, scripts and calls to action

* Create original AI-generated product scenes and UGC-style content

* Turn product photos and approved seller assets into engaging videos

* Generate natural-sounding AI voiceovers when needed

* Edit complete 10–30 second vertical videos

* Add captions, text overlays, music, sound effects and transitions

* Create multiple variations for each product using different hooks

* Deliver finished videos without watermarks

* Organize completed videos, scripts and product links in Google Drive

* Track completed assignments in Google Sheets

* Make reasonable revisions when requested



Approved Content Sources



You may use:



* Product links and information I provide

* Product photos and videos approved for affiliate use

* Seller-provided media

* Licensed stock footage

* AI-generated footage

* Original graphics, scripts, voiceovers and editing



You may not download and repost another creator’s video, remove watermarks or present someone else’s footage as original work.



Video Requirements



* Approximately 10–30 seconds

* Vertical 9:16 format

* Strong hook during the first one to two seconds

* Clear product benefit or problem-and-solution angle

* Engaging visual movement

* Easy-to-read captions

* Natural-sounding voiceover when included

* Clear call to action

* No editing-platform watermarks

* Content must feel native to TikTok—not like a traditional commercial



Because you will not physically possess the products, videos must not falsely claim personal ownership or firsthand experience. Do not use statements such as “I bought this,” “I use this every day” or “This worked for me” unless specifically supported and approved.



Preferred Tools



Experience with several of the following is preferred:



* CapCut

* Canva

* TopView AI

* Creatify

* HeyGen

* Kling

* Runway

* ElevenLabs

* ChatGPT or similar scriptwriting tools

* Google Drive and Google Sheets



You do not need to use every tool, but you must be able to produce a complete, polished video from product information and digital assets.



Requirements



* Experience creating TikTok, Reels, Shorts, AI UGC or product videos

* Strong CapCut or short-form video-editing skills

* Understanding of hooks, viewer retention and calls to action

* Ability to create original content without a physical product

* Strong written English

* Creative thinking and attention to detail

* Reliable internet access

* Responsive communication

* Ability to meet deadlines and follow instructions

* Willingness to learn which video styles produce the most clicks and sales



TikTok Shop and affiliate-marketing experience is preferred, but talented beginners with strong samples are welcome.



Compensation and Schedule



* Starting rate: NEGOTIATED $1.50 - $3.00 per hour 

* Approximately 10–20 hours per week initially

* Flexible working schedule with agreed deadlines

* Paid trial assignment

* Performance bonuses may be available for videos that generate strong views, clicks or sales

* Opportunity to receive additional hours and pay increases based on demonstrated performance



The negotiated starting rate reflects the initial stage of the role and is intended to provide an opportunity to demonstrate your skills in a real production workflow. Compensation may increase as you consistently deliver high-quality, original, compliant videos efficiently and reliably. Any increases or bonuses will be based on factors such as content quality, turnaround time, accuracy, communication, consistency and measurable performance where applicable.



This is a high-volume content position. However, quality, originality and compliance are more important than submitting rushed or repetitive videos.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your name and location

2. A short introduction

3. Links to three short-form videos you created and edited

4. Examples of AI UGC or product videos created without possessing the product

5. A list of the AI and editing tools you use

6. Your weekly availability

7. Your experience with TikTok Shop or affiliate marketing

8. How many polished 10–30 second videos you can realistically complete per hour

9. Your normal turnaround time

10. Confirmation that you can provide the scripts, editable project files and completed videos



Begin your application with “PURPLE AI VIDEO” so I know you read the entire posting.



Shortlisted applicants will complete one small paid test video using the same product link and digital assets. The test will evaluate originality, hook strength, editing, accuracy, communication and ability to follow instructions.



I’m looking for someone creative, honest, dependable and interested in building a long-term working relationship with clear opportunities for growth based on performance.

title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
description:
Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper

Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines





Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Engagement Type: Long-term Independent Contractor

Service Days: Monday to Friday

Reports To: Australian Client Manager

Client Contact: No direct client communication required



About the Role



We are an Australian accounting practice seeking an experienced Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a portfolio of Australian clients.

This is a hands-on, non-client-facing role. You will work directly with an Australian Client Manager, who will manage all external client communication and provide instructions, priorities and review feedback.



You will be responsible for delivering accurate bookkeeping, payroll, BAS/IAS preparation, reconciliations, month-end work and accounting support across multiple Australian entities.

This opportunity is suitable only for candidates with substantial recent experience working within, or directly supporting, an Australian accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or public practice environment.



Key ResponsibilitiesBookkeeping and Reconciliations

· Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Complete bank, credit card, loan and merchant facility reconciliations.

· Reconcile payment platforms such as Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify and Wise.

· Process accounts payable and accounts receivable.

· Process supplier bills, sales invoices, credit notes, refunds and payments.

· Review aged receivables and aged payables.

· Process journals, accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments.

· Reconcile director, shareholder, beneficiary and intercompany loan accounts.

· Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation schedules.

· Investigate unreconciled, duplicated, missing or incorrectly recorded transactions.



Account Code and GST Code Review



This is a senior-level role. You must be able to review the quality and technical accuracy of bookkeeping work.



You will be required to:



· Review and correct account codes.

· Review and correct GST tax codes.

· Identify incorrect use of GST on Income, GST on Expenses, GST-Free, Input Taxed and BAS Excluded codes.

· Review the GST treatment of overseas transactions, exports, reimbursements, disbursements, insurance payments and government grants.

· Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions.

· Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications.

· Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts.

· Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager.

· Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required.



Australian Payroll



· Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll.

· Set up and maintain employee payroll records.

· Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements.

· Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments.

· Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation.

· Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding.

· Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation.

· Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts.

· Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts.

· Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements.



BAS, IAS and Compliance Support



· Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review.

· Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts.

· Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods.

· Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger.

· Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments.

· Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations.

· Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports.

· Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents.

· Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly.



Month-End and Year-End



· Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files.

· Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts.

· Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities.

· Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals.

· Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off.

· Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable.

· Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules.

· Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation.



Financial Reporting



· Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

· Prepare cash flow and management reports where required.

· Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts.

· Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors.

· Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager.



Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential



Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage.



Relevant experience may include:

· Individual and sole trader tax returns.

· Company tax returns.

· Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers.

· Partnership tax returns.

· Rental property schedules.

· Depreciation and capital allowance schedules.

· Tax reconciliation workpapers.

· Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL.



Essential Experience and Skills



Applicants must have:

· At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience.

· Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Advanced practical experience using Xero.

· Strong practical experience using MYOB.

· Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online.

· Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers.

· Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding.

· Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes.

· Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience.

· Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

· Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

· High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

· Ability to use AI tools



Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement.



Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly regarded:

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.

· Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping.

· CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies.

· Xero Advisor Certification.

· MYOB or QuickBooks certification.



Software



You must be confident using:



· Xero

· MYOB

· QuickBooks Online



Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position.



The contractor will:



· Provide services remotely from the Philippines.

· Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements.

· Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations.

· Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice.



The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours.



The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met.



Timesheets and Work Records



The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording:



· Date.

· Client or entity.

· Task performed.

· Time spent.

· Work completed.

· Outstanding issues and next steps.



Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records.

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



· A reliable computer or laptop.

· Stable high-speed internet.

· Backup internet.

· A quiet and secure home office.

· A suitable headset for online meetings.

· The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems.

· A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security.



How to Apply



Please submit:

· Your current resume.

· A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience.

· Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience.

· Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience.

· Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared.

· Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos.

· Your earliest available commencement date.

· Confirmation of your internet.

· Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor.



Pay: Php70,000.00 - Php80,000.00 per month

· Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions.

· Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications.

· Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts.

· Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager.

· Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required.



Australian Payroll



· Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll.

· Set up and maintain employee payroll records.

· Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements.

· Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments.

· Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation.

· Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding.

· Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation.

· Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts.

· Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts.

· Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements.



BAS, IAS and Compliance Support



· Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review.

· Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts.

· Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods.

· Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger.

· Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments.

· Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations.

· Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports.

· Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents.

· Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly.



Month-End and Year-End



· Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files.

· Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts.

· Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities.

· Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals.

· Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off.

· Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable.

· Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules.

· Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation.



Financial Reporting



· Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

· Prepare cash flow and management reports where required.

· Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts.

· Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors.

· Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager.



Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential



Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage.



Relevant experience may include:

· Individual and sole trader tax returns.

· Company tax returns.

· Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers.

· Partnership tax returns.

· Rental property schedules.

· Depreciation and capital allowance schedules.

· Tax reconciliation workpapers.

· Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL.



Essential Experience and Skills



Applicants must have:

· At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience.

· Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Advanced practical experience using Xero.

· Strong practical experience using MYOB.

· Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online.

· Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers.

· Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding.

· Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes.

· Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience.

· Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

· Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

· High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

· Ability to use AI tools



Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement.



Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly regarded:

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.

· Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping.

· CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies.

· Xero Advisor Certification.

· MYOB or QuickBooks certification.



Software



You must be confident using:



· Xero

· MYOB

· QuickBooks Online



Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position.



The contractor will:



· Provide services remotely from the Philippines.

· Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements.

· Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations.

· Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice.



The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours.



The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met.



Timesheets and Work Records



The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording:



· Date.

· Client or entity.

· Task performed.

· Time spent.

· Work completed.

· Outstanding issues and next steps.



Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records.

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



· A reliable computer or laptop.

· Stable high-speed internet.

· Backup internet.

· A quiet and secure home office.

· A suitable headset for online meetings.

· The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems.

· A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security.



How to Apply



Please submit:

· Your current resume.

· A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience.

· Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience.

· Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience.

· Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared.

· Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos.

· Your earliest available commencement date.

· Confirmation of your internet.

· Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor.

title: Social Media Scout | $3-$5/hr + Bonuses & Residual Earnings
description:
THIS IS NOT A TYPICAL SOCIAL MEDIA JOB.



Are you the kind of person who can find almost anything online?



Do you know how to find real conversations happening in
 Groups, Reddit, 
, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Quora, or X?



More importantly, can you recognize when someone is actively looking for help, join the conversation naturally, and make a useful recommendation without sounding like an advertisement?



TaskNuts is hiring Social Media Scouts.



TaskNuts is a U.S.-based home services marketplace that helps homeowners get repairs and maintenance handled while connecting contractors with real jobs.



We are building a human-powered organic customer acquisition team.



We are NOT looking for someone to create content calendars, schedule posts, grow followers, or spam links.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Your job is to find existing online conversations where there is already real intent.



For example:



A homeowner posts:



"Can anyone recommend a reliable handyman? I have several small repairs I need done."



A person asks:



"Does anyone know a plumber who will actually show up?"



A contractor says:



"I'm tired of paying for leads that never turn into jobs."



Your job is to find these conversations, determine whether TaskNuts is genuinely relevant, and participate naturally and helpfully.



You'll primarily be searching for U.S. homeowners who need home repair, maintenance, or improvement services. You may also recruit contractors when TaskNuts is actively seeking additional contractors in a particular market or trade.



YOU DON'T NEED TO BE GREAT AT EVERY PLATFORM



We actually prefer specialists.



Maybe you know
 Groups extremely well.



Maybe Reddit is your world.



Maybe you're great at finding communities on 
.



Maybe you understand TikTok or YouTube search and comments better than everyone else.



We are hiring multiple Scouts with different strengths.



Tell us which platform you are exceptionally good at.



PAY



Base Pay: $3 USD/hour



We are open to starting at approximately 10–20 hours per week during the initial training/performance period.



Scouts who demonstrate strong performance can quickly move to up to 40 hours per week.



But the hourly rate is only one part of the compensation.



You can also earn performance bonuses and ongoing residual bonuses from qualified homeowners and contractors you bring to TaskNuts.



HOMEOWNER BONUSES



$2 for each qualified homeowner signup with a verified property



$20 when that homeowner completes their first TaskNuts job within 60 days



$10 if their first completed job occurs after 60 days



$10 for each subsequent completed job



CONTRACTOR BONUSES



When contractor recruitment is open for the applicable market/trade:



$2 for each qualified contractor signup



$30 when that contractor completes their first TaskNuts job



$2 for each subsequent completed job



THE RESIDUAL OPPORTUNITY



This is what makes the Scout Program different.



Qualified homeowners and contractors you acquire remain attributed to your Scout account while you remain eligible under the TaskNuts Scout Program.



If a homeowner you recruited returns months later and completes another job, that activity can generate another bonus for you.



If you recruit a great contractor who goes on to complete many TaskNuts jobs, their future completed jobs can continue generating bonuses for you.



The goal is to build a growing book of TaskNuts users, not simply work hours.



Performance and residual earnings are not guaranteed and are subject to TaskNuts Scout Program qualification rules and continued good standing.



YOUR SCOUT PORTAL



Every Scout receives their own TaskNuts Scout Portal and unique referral links.



You'll be able to see:



Homeowners you've acquired

Contractors you've acquired

Qualified signups

Completed-job activity

Bonuses and residuals you've earned

Your referral links

TaskNuts Share Center resources



We handle the attribution and tracking so you can focus on finding opportunities.



WHAT WE DO NOT WANT



We do not want spam.



No fake testimonials.



No pretending to be a TaskNuts customer.



No fake U.S. identities.



No mass copy-and-paste comments.



No indiscriminate link dropping.



No bots or automated mass posting.



No circumventing
 Group, subreddit, 
 server, or other community rules.



We want Scouts who understand how to become useful participants in online communities.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



Strong written English

A good understanding of natural U.S. online conversation

Excellent internet research skills

Resourcefulness

Good judgment

An understanding of online communities

The ability to recognize real buying intent

The ability to work independently

A performance-driven mindset



Experience with social media, lead generation, community management, online research, or customer acquisition is helpful, but resourcefulness matters more to us than your previous job title.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the exact words:



I FOUND THE CONVERSATION



Then answer these 5 questions:



1. Rank these platforms from strongest to weakest for you:



, Reddit, 
, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Quora, X.



Which ONE are you exceptionally good at, and why?



2. A homeowner in a U.S.
 group posts:



"Can anyone recommend a reliable handyman? I have several small repairs."



Write EXACTLY what you would reply if you wanted to naturally introduce TaskNuts.



3. You are assigned St. Louis, Missouri and need to find homeowners actively looking for repair help. Describe 3 specific ways you would find these conversations using your strongest platform.



4. What accounts would you actually use to perform this work? Tell us whether they are existing personal/professional accounts, approximately how established they are, and whether you currently participate in U.S.-focused communities.



Do not create fake U.S. identities or accounts for this application.



5. You work 15 hours during your first week but generate zero qualified signups. What would you analyze, change, or test during week two?



We are looking to hire quickly and want Scouts interested in building a long-term position and a growing book of residual earnings with TaskNuts.

This role is focused on content creation, video editing, social media, and copywriting. We’re looking for someone who can bring creative ideas to the table — not just wait for instructions or create generic AI-generated content.



MUST-HAVE SKILLS



* Excellent written English and grammar

* Reliable communicator who meets deadlines

* Stable internet + backup internet connection



**BONUS SKILLS:** Experience with beauty, fashion, lifestyle, e-commerce, UGC, influencer marketing, Shopify, or
 marketing.



A NOTE ABOUT AI



We’re completely fine with using AI as a tool for brainstorming and efficiency, but we are not looking for generic AI-generated content.



Your work should feel creative, thoughtful, current, and specific to our brand. We value human creativity, taste, and good judgment.



 WHAT YOU’LL DO



* Edit content: carousels, Reels/TikToks from raw footage

* Create hooks, captions, text overlays, and content concepts

* Repurpose footage into multiple pieces of content

*

* Research beauty and social media trends

* Create simple graphics, carousels, and Stories

* Help plan and maintain our content calendar

* Source and organize UGC

* Help find and communicate with creators/influencers

* Assist with gifting and affiliate partnerships

* Schedule and publish social content

* Engage with our audience and relevant accounts

* Track what’s performing and suggest ways we can improve

* Regularly bring new content ideas to the team



We want someone who can look at our brand and think:



"Here’s what we should post next.”



WHO YOU ARE



You’re creative, organized, dependable, and genuinely interested in social media.



You notice the little things. You know why one Reel catches your attention while another gets skipped. You’re comfortable sharing ideas, learning from feedback, and figuring things out without needing step-by-step instructions every time.



Most importantly, you care about the quality of your work and want to grow with a brand long-term.



HOURS



This is a 100% remote position with flexible hours. You can primarily work within your own time zone, but reliable communication and meeting deadlines are important.



We care more about quality, productivity, and result than having you online during every working hour.



This position will begin with a paid trial/probationary period to make sure we’re a great fit for each other.



Compensation will depend on experience and skill level, with plenty of room to grow based on performance.



BENEFITS + PERKS



**After 6 months of full-time employment:**



* 10 days paid time off

* A gift on your birthday each year 

* End-of-year performance bonus

* Frequent raises based on skill + performance

* Additional bonuses for exceptional work

* Flexible working hours

* 100% remote work

* Opportunities to grow into a larger role as the company grows



 HOW TO APPLY



**Please follow ALL instructions below to be considered.**



Start your application with **“ELORA Content Creator”** and include:



**1. Short Introduction**

Tell us about yourself, your social media/content experience, and why this role interests you.



**2. Portfolio**

Send examples of Reels/TikToks, social content, designs, or captions you’ve personally created. Beauty, fashion, or lifestyle work is a plus.



**3. Content Test**

Visit 
 and choose ONE existing Reel/post you think could be improved. Tell us:



* What you would change and why

* A better hook/text-on-screen

* A new caption



**4. Give us 3 content ideas  you would create for our brand. Include a hook + short concept for each.



**5. Video Editing Samples**

Send 1–3 short-form videos you personally edited.



**6. Trend Research**

Show us ONE current Instagram/TikTok trend you think would work for a lash brand and briefly tell us how you would use it.



Applications that do not follow the instructions above may not be considered.

 

If you love beauty content, have a strong creative eye, and want to grow alongside an emerging beauty brand, we’d love to meet you!

title: Operations & Executive Assistant
description:

description:
Virtual Recruiter & Client Care Coordinator (Remote)



20-30 hours/week, with possibility to convert to full-time within a month



We're seeking a detail-oriented, personable Recruiting & Client Care Coordinator to join our growing team. This role blends caregiver recruiting with client-facing coordination, helping us bring on great caregivers while ensuring smooth scheduling, documentation, and continuity of care for our clients.



Key Responsibilities :



Recruiting & Hiring



Post and manage caregiver job listings across job boards

Screen resumes and applications for caregiver roles

Conduct initial phone screens with candidates

Schedule interviews and coordinate with hiring team

Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process

Track applicant status and maintain a candidate pipeline

Support onboarding coordination for new hires

Collect required documents (IDs, W-4, availability, background check info)

Support administrative aspects of scheduling changes and service adjustments

title: Experienced Etsy + Printify Listing Specialist – $300 Project
description:
I am launching a new Etsy print-on-demand store and am hiring 2 experienced Etsy + Printify Listing Specialists to help build the shop.



Each person will be responsible for creating 75 complete, professional, SEO-optimized Etsy listings within 14 days.



IMPORTANT — EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



This position is for experienced Etsy + Printify specialists only.



Because of the fast 14-day project timeline, I will not have time to train someone on Etsy, Printify, POD, Etsy SEO, keyword research, or listing creation.



You must already know how to independently create a complete, professional Etsy listing from start to finish using Printify.



Please do not apply if you are new to Etsy, Printify, or print-on-demand.



I will provide shop-specific instructions and expectations, but I am looking for someone who can begin working immediately without needing training on the platforms or basic listing procedures.



COMPENSATION



$300 USD Fixed Project



75 approved listings × $4 per listing = $300



This is a short-term project with the possibility of additional work for excellent performance.



Selected applicants will begin with a paid 3-listing test ($12) before receiving the full assignment.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will be provided with the products and general shop instructions.



For each assigned product, you will:



Create and set up the product in Printify

Configure correct sizes, colors and variants

Create or select attractive, professional product mockups

Prepare and publish the product to Etsy

Conduct Etsy keyword and competitor research

Write an SEO-optimized Etsy title

Write a clear, persuasive, SEO-friendly description

Create all 13 relevant Etsy tags

Select appropriate Etsy categories and attributes

Set up clear personalization instructions when applicable

Properly organize listing photos

Follow provided pricing instructions

Check spelling, grammar and product information

Perform final quality control before submitting the listing for approval

SEO EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



This is not simply a product-uploading position.



You must already understand Etsy SEO and be able to make intelligent decisions about:



Buyer search terms

Long-tail keywords

Etsy titles

Etsy tags

Categories

Attributes

Search intent

Personalized product keywords

Competitor and keyword research



Do not simply copy the same title, tags and description from one listing to another.



Each listing should be individually optimized for the specific product and target customer.



PRODUCT TYPE



The store primarily sells personalized Printify products.



Customers will be able to add their own words, quotes, sayings, phrases, messages and other personalized text to products.



Experience creating listings for personalized or customizable Etsy products is strongly preferred.



You should already understand how to make the personalization process simple and clear for customers.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must already have hands-on experience with:



Etsy listing creation

Printify

Print-on-demand products

Etsy SEO

Etsy keyword research

Etsy titles, tags, categories and attributes

Personalized/custom products

Product mockups

Canva or similar tools

Strong written English



This is NOT a beginner or training position.



I need someone who can receive instructions, understand the project requirements, and immediately begin producing professional listings independently.



WORKLOAD



75 completed and approved listings



14-day deadline



This averages approximately 5–6 completed listings per day.



The deadline is firm.



Please apply only if you have enough availability to complete the project on time without sacrificing quality.



QUALITY REQUIREMENTS



A listing will be considered complete when it is accurate, polished, customer-ready and meets the project instructions.



Listings should include:



Strong Etsy SEO

Relevant keyword research

Professional mockups

Accurate product information

Correct variants

Clear personalization instructions

Proper categories and attributes

All 13 relevant tags

Professional description

Correct spelling and grammar

Final quality check



Rushed, incomplete, duplicated or poorly optimized listings will require correction before approval.



PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants will complete:



3 paid Etsy + Printify listings



Payment: $12 USD



The test will evaluate:



SEO and keyword research

Title quality

Tags

Description

Mockups

Accuracy

Attention to detail

Printify setup

Personalization setup

Overall Etsy listing quality



The test is intended to verify your existing skills, not to train you.



Applicants who demonstrate the required experience may then receive the remaining listings for the full project.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the following:



How many Etsy listings have you personally created?

How many years or months have you worked with Etsy?

How much hands-on experience do you have with Printify?

Have you created Etsy listings for personalized/custom products?

Please provide examples of Etsy listings you personally created.

What tools do you use for Etsy keyword research?

What tools do you use for product mockups?

Briefly explain how you research keywords for a new Etsy product.

Approximately how long does it take you to create one complete Etsy + Printify listing?

Can you independently create listings without Etsy or Printify training?

Can you consistently complete 5–6 quality listings per day?

Can you complete 75 listings within 14 days?

Do you agree to the $300 project rate based on 75 completed and approved listings at $4 each?

Are you willing to complete the 3-listing paid test first?



To show that you read the entire posting, begin your application with:



QUOTE DIVA



Applications that do not include this phrase or do not demonstrate previous Etsy + Printify experience will not be considered.



PROJECT DETAILS



Position: Experienced Etsy + Printify Listing Specialist

Type: Short-Term Project

Project Length: 2 Weeks

Listings Per VA: 75

Total Pay Per VA: $300 USD

Rate: $4 per completed and approved listing

Paid Test: 3 listings / $12

Number of People Being Hired: 2

Training: None — prior experience required



Excellent work may lead to additional listing projects and ongoing Etsy store support.

title: Meta Ads Specialist
description:
About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Meta Ads Specialist to plan, build, and scale paid social campaigns across
 and Instagram. You'll own campaign strategy, creative testing, budget management, and reporting. If you live in Ads Manager, obsess over ROAS/CPA, and can prove your results with real numbers, we want to talk to you.



Responsibilities

- Build, launch, and optimize Meta ad campaigns (Advantage+, ABO/CBO, retargeting, lookalikes)

- Structure campaigns for clear testing: audiences, placements, and creatives

- Write ad copy briefs and direct creative for testing (static, carousel, video/UGC)

- Manage daily budgets and pacing to hit CPA / ROAS targets

- Set up and troubleshoot Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), and event tracking

- Monitor performance daily, kill losers, scale winners

- Deliver clear weekly reporting with insights and next steps



Requirements

- 2+ years managing Meta ads with real budget accountability

- Strong grasp of the Meta Ads Manager, Business Manager, and Events Manager

- Experience with Pixel + Conversions API setup and troubleshooting

- Comfortable analyzing metrics (CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPM, frequency, hook rate)

- Solid written English and clear communicator

- Reliable internet, able to overlap with US working hours (please state your availability)



? How to Apply — READ CAREFULLY (applications that skip this will be ignored)



To be considered, your application must include:



1. Two to three case studies of Meta ad accounts you've managed. For each, tell us:

------  The niche/industry and monthly ad spend you managed

------  Starting point vs. results (ROAS, CPA, revenue, or leads — with real numbers)

------  What you specifically did to get those results



2. Screenshots of Ads Manager dashboards or reports showing performance (blur out client names if needed — we just want to see the numbers)



3. Examples of ad creatives you helped produce or direct (links or images)



4. A short note on your weekly availability and hours of overlap with US Pacific time



5. Start your application with the word "SCALE" so we know you read this

ENGLISH TEACHERS

English4Everyone (E4E) is a growing English education company based in Bali, Indonesia. We are looking for

passionate, professional English teachers to join our team.



We currently have two opportunities:

• Remote English Teacher — work remotely from the Philippines

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Strong communication and pronunciation

• Experience teaching English, preferably to children

• Experience with students ages 4–15 is a strong advantage

• Energetic, friendly, patient, and engaging personality

• Able to create fun, interactive, student-centered lessons

• Comfortable teaching grammar, vocabulary, phonics, speaking, reading, listening, and writing

• Reliable, professional, and punctual

• Comfortable receiving training, observations, and feedback

We are not simply looking for someone who speaks English. We are looking for a teacher who can make

students excited to learn. Our teachers should build confidence, encourage students to speak, explain clearly,

WHAT WE OFFER

• Competitive salary — discussed based on experience and qualifications

• Training and support from the E4E management team

• Structured curriculum and teaching materials

• Professional development and opportunities to grow with the company

English4Everyone • Bali, Indonesia

title: Customer Success and Implementation Manager
description:
About DCRM



DCRM is a CRM and automation platform for private dental practices in Australia. We help practices improve lead response, appointment conversion, missed-call handling, client communication and marketing attribution.



We are hiring a Customer Success and Implementation Manager to own the client journey from signed agreement through implementation, onboarding and ongoing success.



This is not a general virtual assistant, documentation or customer support role. You will assess situations, recommend the next action, coordinate the people involved and drive work through to completion.



DCRM is still developing some of its operating playbooks. You will work closely with our Process and Knowledge Coordinator, who owns process documentation, templates, checklists and knowledge maintenance. Your responsibility is to make sound operational decisions, lead client outcomes and identify recurring situations or process gaps for documentation.



What you will own



• Sales-to-Customer-Success handover

• Client implementation plans, deadlines and dependencies

• Data collection and implementation readiness

• Client onboarding and training calls

• Pre-launch testing and quality control

• Coordination with technical and operations team members

• Clear client updates, expectations and next steps

• Escalations with a recommended decision

• Account health, adoption and retention

• Identification of recurring issues and process gaps for the Process and Knowledge Coordinator



What the Process and Knowledge Coordinator owns



• Building and maintaining playbooks

• Updating checklists, templates and the Customer Success knowledge base

• Documenting repeatable lessons from completed client work

• Maintaining ClickUp process records

• Supporting consistent execution across the team



What success looks like



• Clients always know what is happening, who owns the next step and when they will hear from us

• Risks are identified before they affect a launch

• Technical issues are explained in simple language

• Work progresses without constant founder follow-up

• Client communication is concise, confident and action-oriented

• Implementation tasks are completed accurately and on time

• Process gaps are identified clearly and handed to the Process and Knowledge Coordinator after the operational decision is made



Required experience



• 3 or more years in B2B SaaS customer success, software implementation, account management or a similar client-facing role

• Experience owning client onboarding from handover through launch

• Strong spoken and written English

• Experience coordinating technical delivery without needing to be a developer

• Confidence leading video calls with Australian business clients

• Strong CRM and project-management experience

• Sound judgment when information is incomplete

• Reliable internet, professional video-call setup and availability during Australian business hours



Preferred experience



• Australian client experience

• Healthcare, dental, agency or professional-services experience

• Experience with GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM automation platform such as HubSpot, Salesforce or ActiveCampaign

• Experience managing multiple client accounts

• Experience working alongside process, quality or knowledge-management roles

• Commercial awareness around retention and account growth



How to apply



Please provide these details in writing:



• Your location

• The Australian business hours you are available to work

• Your years of relevant experience

• Your current or most recent role

• Your expected monthly salary

• A link to your Loom video



Loom video assessment



Record one continuous Loom video of no more than 5 minutes. No editing or special production is required. Answer all five questions in your own words:



1. Summarise your most relevant Customer Success or implementation experience.



2. Describe your GoHighLevel or CRM implementation experience. Explain what you personally owned rather than what your wider team delivered.



3. Give one example where you received an unclear client problem, formed a recommendation and drove it to resolution.



4. A dental practice is launching its new CRM in three days. SMS is not working, the developer says implementation is complete, required information is missing and the Practice Manager wants an update today. Explain what you would say to the Practice Manager and what you would do next.



5. Explain why you are suited to working in a business where some playbooks are still being developed.



We assess clarity, judgment, ownership, concision and client communication. We do not assess accent, camera quality or video editing.



Selection process



• Application review

• Short video and written scenario assessment

• Live interview

• Paid practical trial for finalists

• Reference check



Compensation



PHP 63,000 to PHP 74,000 per month, based on demonstrated experience and practical assessment.



This is a full-time, long-term remote role with direct access to the DCRM business owner and meaningful ownership of client outcomes.

title: Editor
description:
Here’s a tighter, compelling version designed to attract a storyteller, not just a technician.



PART-TIME VIDEO EDITOR & STORYTELLER



Help us turn a real family journey into a growing media brand.



We’re looking for a talented part-time video editor with strong storytelling instincts to help us document an unusual season of family life, business, travel, faith and personal growth.



This isn’t a role for someone who simply cuts clips together.



We need someone who can watch raw footage and recognise:



There’s a story in here.



Then bring it to life.



ABOUT US



We are The Banfords, an Australian family currently spending an extended period in Thailand, primarily Phuket.



A lot of our content currently follows Laura and her 10-year-old son Harrison as we live, work, train and learn together.



We’re documenting:



* Travelling and living through Thailand

* Homeschooling on the road

* Muay Thai, boxing and fitness

* Thai culture and everyday life

* Building and running businesses remotely

* Discipline, confidence and resilience

* Mother-and-son conversations and family moments

* Our Christian faith as it naturally appears in our lives

* The wins, mistakes, difficult days and funny moments along the way



At the centre of what we do are Faith, Family, Fitness, Freedom and Purpose.



We don’t want fake influencer content.



We don’t want cheesy family-vlogger content.



And we don’t want everything polished to the point where it stops feeling real.



Our style is honest, grounded, hopeful, strong and conviction-led.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We’re looking for an editor who wants to become part of building something over time.



Initially, this is a part-time remote role, but there is significant potential for the workload to grow as our YouTube channel, family brand and personal brands develop.



We will send you raw footage from phones, cameras and potentially action cameras.



Your job is to turn that footage into finished, platform-ready content that requires little or no additional editing from us.



Content will include:



* Instagram Reels

*
 Reels and video

* YouTube Shorts

* Longer-form YouTube episodes



You need to understand that editing a 30-second Reel and building an engaging 15-minute YouTube episode require very different storytelling skills.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING



You’ll be responsible for:



* Reviewing raw footage and identifying the strongest moments

* Finding hooks, storylines and emotional beats

* Cutting unnecessary footage

* Creating engaging pacing without making everything frantic

* Knowing when to edit quickly and when to let a moment breathe

* Building strong opening hooks and maintaining retention

* Music selection

* Sound design

* Colour correction and basic grading

* Captions and subtitles

* Clean transitions

* Basic motion graphics where they genuinely add value

* Formatting videos correctly for each platform

* Turning longer footage into multiple short-form pieces where appropriate

* Delivering finished exports ready to upload

* Potentially helping with YouTube titles, hooks and thumbnail concepts



For thumbnails, we generally favour simple, bold, high-contrast concepts built around ONE clear idea rather than cluttered designs.



THE EDITING STYLE



Think:



Documentary storytelling meets modern social-media editing.



One video could be Harrison training Muay Thai, travelling somewhere new or taking on a challenge.



The next could be Laura and Harrison having a conversation about confidence, a difficult homeschooling day, a reflection on faith, a business discussion or a moment that is genuinely emotional.



We need an editor with enough judgement to know the difference.



We are not looking for someone who adds transitions, emojis, graphics, zooms and sound effects every two seconds because they can.



Story comes first.



The edit should enhance what happened — not overpower it.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Ideally, you:



* Have proven professional video-editing experience

* Understand Instagram,
 and YouTube

* Understand hooks, retention and modern social-media behaviour

* Have strong storytelling instincts

* Understand longer-form YouTube structure

* Can work independently without needing every edit explained

* Are reliable with deadlines and turnaround times

* Communicate clearly

* Are comfortable receiving large amounts of raw footage

* Are organised with files and projects

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Are willing to understand our family, values and bigger mission

* Can develop and maintain a consistent editing style over time



Most importantly, we want someone who cares about the story.



BONUS SKILLS



Experience in any of the following would be valuable:



* YouTube channel editing

* Documentary editing

* Travel content

* Fitness or combat-sports content

* Family/lifestyle content

* Personal brands

* Christian or faith-based content



Faith is part of our story, but we are not trying to make every piece of content feel like a religious advertisement.



You do not need to share all of our beliefs, but you do need to respect our Christian values and be comfortable editing content where faith naturally appears.



WHAT THE CONTENT CAN LOOK LIKE



One week you might be editing:



A high-energy Muay Thai training session.



A funny travel moment.



A challenge Harrison takes on.



A Thailand adventure.



Another week it might be:



A mother and son talking honestly about life.



A difficult day homeschooling.



A reflection about faith.



A conversation about business, purpose or discipline.



A quiet family moment that doesn’t need much editing at all.



We want somebody who can recognise what each story needs rather than forcing every video into the same template.



HOURS & WORKING ARRANGEMENT



* Part-time initially

* Fully remote

* Flexible location

* Ongoing weekly content

* Potential to develop into considerably more work over time



We are much more interested in building a long-term relationship with one great editor who understands our style than constantly cycling through freelancers.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Where you are based

3. Your editing experience

4. Links to 3 examples of your BEST work

5. At least one strong short-form example

6. At least one longer-form storytelling example, if available

7. Your usual turnaround time

8. Your preferred pricing structure — hourly, per video, weekly retainer or monthly retainer

9. What editing software you use

10. Why you believe you would suit this specific project



PLEASE DO NOT SEND US 30 RANDOM VIDEOS.



We would rather watch three exceptional edits that clearly demonstrate your taste, judgement and storytelling ability.



Quality over quantity.



PAID EDITING TEST



Applicants who make the shortlist will be invited to complete a small paid editing test using footage supplied by us.



We may give the same raw footage to several shortlisted editors.



This allows us to compare how each person interprets the exact same material — including:



* Story selection

* Opening hook

* Pacing

* Music

* Creativity

* Emotional judgement

* Retention

* Overall feel



We’re not looking for someone to simply copy our instructions.



We want to see what you see in the footage.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



This isn’t just another freelance editing job.



You would be helping shape the way a real family story is documented while we travel, homeschool, train, build businesses, raise a son, explore faith and figure things out as we go.



There will be great moments.



There will be difficult moments.



There will be funny moments.



There will be stories we probably don’t even realise we’re capturing until a great editor sees them.



If you’re the type of editor who watches raw footage and immediately starts thinking about story, emotion, tension, character and what happens next, we’d love to hear from you.



Come help us build the story of The Banfords.

title: B2B Cold Caller & Appointment Setter
description:
We are a UK-based digital marketing agency helping window and door installers, roofers and other home-improvement companies generate more local homeowner enquiries.



We are looking for a confident and reliable cold caller to contact UK home-improvement business owners and book qualified strategy calls for our team.



This is genuine cold calling. The businesses have not requested a call and may not be familiar with our agency. You must be comfortable starting conversations, handling rejection and speaking naturally without sounding as though you are reading from a script.



This is primarily an appointment-setting role, not a hard-closing sales position.



What You’ll Do

- Make outbound cold calls to UK window and door companies and other selected home-improvement businesses

- Ask for the owner or relevant decision-maker

- Introduce our lead-generation service using the script and talking points provided

- Ask qualifying questions and book short strategy calls with interested prospects

- Handle common objections calmly and professionally

- Log every call outcome immediately in our spreadsheet or CRM

- Arrange callbacks and complete agreed follow-ups

- Provide a short end-of-day report covering calls, conversations, appointments and blockers

- Follow up promptly with inbound leads if and when they are assigned



What We Provide

- A pre-built prospect list

- UK calling software and business number

- Cold-calling script

- Objection-handling guide

- Regular feedback and support



You will not be expected to source your own leads or use your personal telephone number.



Two-Week Trial Expectations

During the paid trial, we expect approximately:

- 50–55 call attempts daily

- 500–550 call attempts across two weeks

- Accurate logging of every outcome

- Consistent follow-up on callbacks

- Genuine qualified appointments, not unconfirmed or unsuitable bookings



Performance will be assessed based on reliability, call quality, decision-maker conversations, accurate reporting and qualified appointments, not call volume alone.



What We’re Looking For

- Excellent spoken English that is clear and easy for UK business owners to understand

- Previous cold-calling, telemarketing, appointment-setting or BPO experience

- B2B calling experience is strongly preferred

- Confident and conversational telephone manner

- Ability to follow a script without sounding robotic
