title: Product Research & Development Associate
description:
# Product Research & Development Associate



**Full-time | Remote | Product Department**



We are a UK-based e-commerce company operating across the USA, UK and EU, with a growing portfolio of health and children's products.



We are looking for a highly **curious, analytical and commercially minded** person to identify the next generation of products for our business.



Your job is to find opportunities, investigate them deeply and determine **whether they are actually worth pursuing**.



### What You Will Do



**Product & Market Research**



* Research new product opportunities within our niches

* Identify trends, customer needs and market gaps

* Find product variations, line extensions and improvements

* Research competitors, pricing, positioning and features

* Analyse customer reviews to understand what people love, dislike and want improved



**Validate Product Opportunities**



Before we invest time and money developing a product, you will help determine:



* Is there genuine demand?

* What problem does it solve?

* Who is the target customer?

* What are customers currently buying?

* What are competitors failing to solve?

* What could we do differently?

* How competitive is the market?

* What price could we sell at?

* What are likely product costs and margins?

* Is this opportunity commercially worthwhile?



We don't want research for the sake of research.



We want to know: **“Should we make this product — and why?”**



### Customer Insight



You will also become responsible for systematically learning from our existing customers.



You will:



* Collect and analyse customer reviews and complaints

* Identify recurring product problems and requested features

* Categorise feedback and identify patterns

* Track changes in customer feedback

* Turn customer insights into product improvement recommendations



You will pass these insights to our **China-based Product Development Specialist**, who will investigate and solve the physical product issues.



### Product Development & Pipeline



Once a product is approved, you will continue supporting development with:



* Customer research

* Competitor analysis

* Target customer requirements

* Feature recommendations

* Pricing and positioning research

* Market trends

* Key problems the product must solve



You will also maintain our **product opportunity pipeline**, research documents, customer feedback and project information, ensuring important insights and decisions don't get lost.



### We Are Looking For Someone Who



* Is naturally curious and constantly asks **“why?”**

* Has excellent research, analytical and critical-thinking skills

* Thinks commercially rather than simply finding “interesting” products

* Can distinguish a genuinely attractive opportunity from a bad one

* Is comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets and data

* Can turn large amounts of customer feedback into clear insights

* Has excellent written communication and organisation skills

* Is proactive and takes ownership

* Has strong attention to detail



Experience in **e-commerce, Amazon, product research, market research, product management or consumer products** is strongly preferred.



Experience with Amazon research tools, Google Trends, competitor intelligence tools and spreadsheets is an advantage.



### The Type of Person We Want



We are **not looking for someone who simply searches Amazon and produces product lists.**



If you see a product with 10,000 reviews, we want you asking:



**Why is it selling? Who is buying it? What are customers complaining about? What are competitors failing to solve? Could we build something meaningfully better? Would customers pay enough for it to be profitable?**



You should be comfortable challenging assumptions and telling us when an idea **isn't good enough to pursue**.



We are a remote female team that moves quickly, takes work seriously and invests in training and development. **We do not do graveyard hours.**



**Full-time | Competitive salary based on experience**



### To Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. 2 examples of product research you personally completed and the conclusions you reached

3. One product opportunity you identified and why it was commercially attractive

4. One customer problem/insight you identified from reviews and what action you recommended

5. One product you think is currently poorly designed or underserved and how you would improve it

Direct Response

Founder / Brand Story



You should understand that sometimes changing the first 2–3 seconds of an ad can matter more than changing the rest of the video.



This Role Is Different From a Traditional Video Editor



We care about how the creative performs, not just how beautiful the edit looks.



You should be interested in questions such as:



Why did Creative A get a 2% CTR while Creative B got 0.7%?

Why are people watching the video but not clicking?

Which hook should we test next?

Should we make more versions of a winning creative?

Is the problem the hook, product angle, offer, pacing, or CTA?

What can we learn from competitor ads?



You do NOT need to be an expert media buyer.



However, you should either understand or be willing to learn basic performance metrics such as:



CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR, CPA, ROAS, Hook Rate and Creative Fatigue.



Responsibilities



You will:



Edit Meta and TikTok video ads

Repurpose creator and UGC footage into multiple ad variations

Develop and test different hooks

Create different openings, captions, CTAs and pacing

Identify strong moments inside longer creator videos

Research competitor and winning DTC ad creatives

Suggest new creative concepts and angles

Use AI tools to accelerate scripting and creative production

Organize creatives systematically for testing

Review performance results with our team

Create new iterations based on advertising data

Build variations of winning creatives instead of constantly starting from zero

Required Skills



We are looking for someone with experience in several of the following areas:



DTC / e-commerce advertising

Meta /
 video ads

TikTok ads

UGC advertising

Direct-response video editing

Short-form advertising

Creator content

CapCut / Adobe Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve

AI creative tools

Ad creative research



Strong English comprehension is important because our customers and creators are primarily based in the United States.



Strongly Preferred



Experience working with:



Shopify brands

U.S. DTC brands

Home & Kitchen

Beauty

Fashion

Consumer products

Dropshipping brands

Performance marketing agencies



Experience creating ads that have actually been used with paid advertising is significantly more important to us than cinematic editing experience.



What We DO NOT Need



We are not primarily looking for:



Movie-style editors

YouTube long-form editors

Wedding editors

Corporate video editors

Editors focused mainly on transitions and visual effects



Beautiful editing is helpful, but advertising performance is the priority.



What Success Looks Like



Initially, you may produce approximately:



15–25 creative variations per week



using a combination of existing creator content and new footage.



However, your performance will NOT be evaluated only by how many videos you edit.



Our goal is to build a repeatable system:



Creative → Test → Data → Learn → Iterate → Winning Creative → Scale



Over time, we want you to understand what makes Alorivo customers click and buy, and become an important part of our growth team.



To Apply

Please do NOT send a general video editing showreel unless it includes paid social ads.

Meta Ads / TikTok Ads / UGC / DTC / Shopify / Direct Response

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)

We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

s.

s.

• Track replies and next actions.



• Help schedule partnership and discovery calls with the founder.

, LinkedIn, Instagram, and relevant educational communities.

s and responses.

title: Performance Creative Strategist & Meta Ads Operator
description:
Performance Creative Strategist & Meta Ads Operator



Full-Time Remote

$800/month + Uncapped Performance Bonuses



ABOUT THE POSITION



We are looking for a highly creative, performance-driven person to take ownership of the creative pipeline for a profitable digital product advertised primarily through Meta Ads.



This is NOT a traditional Media Buyer position.



Your main objective is simple:



Find and create winning ads — and produce them at scale.



We already have a product that converts and profitable Meta campaigns.



Our biggest bottleneck is creative volume.



We want to go from testing a handful of ads to continuously testing new concepts, angles, hooks and formats every day.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will own the creative process from research to launch:



* Research competitors daily using Meta Ad Library and other sources

* Identify winning advertising concepts, formats, hooks and angles

* Understand WHY competitor ads work instead of simply copying them

* Develop new advertising angles for our product

* Create video ads

* Create static/image ads

* Create UGC-style and native-looking ads

* Use AI image/video tools to dramatically increase creative output

* Write hooks, headlines and ad copy

* Create multiple variations of promising concepts

* Upload and launch creatives directly inside Meta Ads Manager

* Analyze CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS and creative-level performance

* Identify winning creatives

* Iterate aggressively on winners

* Kill weak ideas and continuously replace them with new tests



EXPECTED CREATIVE OUTPUT



We operate with a high-volume testing philosophy.



You should be capable of producing approximately 5–10 new ad variations per working day.



This does NOT mean inventing 10 completely new concepts every day.



For example:



3 new concepts

x 3 different hooks/variations

= 9 ads to test



Speed and iteration are extremely important.



We would rather test 100 good ideas quickly than spend one week making one "perfect" advertisement.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should understand:



* Meta Ads

* Direct-response advertising

* Creative testing

* Hooks

* Marketing angles

* Customer psychology

* UGC advertising

* Video editing

* Static ads

* Meta Ad Library research

* CTR / CPC / CPA / ROAS

* Creative iteration



Experience with tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop or similar is useful.



Experience using AI tools for image generation, video generation, voice generation or UGC production is a major advantage.



We care about performance, not beautiful branding.



An ugly ad generating a 3.0 ROAS is more valuable to us than a beautiful ad generating a 0.8 ROAS.



COMPENSATION



Base salary: $800 USD/month



PLUS performance bonuses.



There is no fixed ceiling on your compensation.



Examples of monthly scaling bonuses:



$10,000+ ad spend while maintaining 1.50+ ROAS = $200 bonus



$20,000+ ad spend while maintaining 1.50+ ROAS = $400 bonus



$30,000+ ad spend while maintaining 1.50+ ROAS = $600 bonus



$50,000+ ad spend while maintaining 1.50+ ROAS = $1,000 bonus



Exceptional performance can result in additional bonuses.



WINNING CREATIVE BONUS



You can also receive bonuses for individual winning concepts.



A creative that reaches meaningful spend while remaining profitable can qualify for an additional performance bonus.



The better the creatives perform and the more we are able to scale, the more you earn.



Our goal is to create a situation where a great Creative Strategist can earn significantly more than the $800 base salary.



IMPORTANT



We are NOT looking for:



* A generic Social Media Manager

* Someone focused on organic Instagram content

* Someone who only knows graphic design

* Someone who needs detailed instructions for every creative

* Someone who creates beautiful videos but doesn't understand performance marketing



We ARE looking for someone who thinks:



Research → Hypothesis → Creative → Test → Data → Iteration → Scale



You will have significant creative freedom.



If you see an interesting advertising format from another industry, test it.



If you see a competitor doing something interesting, understand why it works and adapt the principle.



If one of our ads starts performing extremely well, create new iterations of it.



We want someone obsessed with finding the next winning creative.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Examples of Meta ads you personally created.

2. Screenshots of Ads Manager results associated with your creatives, if available.

3. Your experience with Meta Ads.

4. The AI tools you currently use for creative production.

5. Your experience with video editing.

6. Your experience researching competitors and Meta Ad Library.



Finally, choose one advertisement from your portfolio and explain:



* Why you believe it performed well

* What its main hook/angle was

* What 3 variations you would test next



Applications without examples of previous advertising work will not be considered.

title: Health & Medical News Writer – Remote
description:
We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Health & Medical News Writer to join our growing editorial team. This role focuses on health news, medical developments, scientific research, wellness, nutrition, symptoms and conditions, mental health, fitness, NHS-related topics, and major health stories affecting the public.



The ideal candidate has a strong interest in health and medicine, understands the importance of evidence-based reporting, and can quickly turn complex medical and scientific developments into clear, accurate, engaging, and accessible news articles.



This role is ideal for someone who can identify compelling health stories while maintaining responsible reporting standards and carefully distinguishing established evidence from emerging research, expert opinion, and anecdotal claims.



Work Schedule: 



Monday to Friday, 4:00 PM to 12:00 AM (Philippine Time)



Key Responsibilities



> Write original health and medical news articles during the weekday shift

> Cover topics including medical breakthroughs, health research, symptoms and conditions, nutrition, wellness, mental health, fitness, NHS developments, public health, and medical treatments

> Monitor breaking health news, scientific developments, medical research, social media platforms, Reddit, and trending health discussions for potential story ideas

> Identify emerging health topics, studies, public concerns, and viral claims that can be developed into accurate and engaging news stories

> Research stories using credible medical, scientific, government, NHS, academic, and news sources

> Review research papers and studies and accurately explain their findings, limitations, and significance

> Fact-check all medical, scientific, and health-related information before submission

> Seek relevant expert commentary or professional perspectives when appropriate

> Clearly distinguish between established medical evidence, emerging research, expert opinion, personal experiences, and unverified claims

> Write clear, engaging, and well-structured articles for a broad audience

> Create compelling, SEO-friendly headlines with strong click-through potential without misleading readers

> Follow editorial guidelines and maintain high standards of accuracy and responsible health reporting

Meet daily publishing deadlines and maintain consistent article output



Requirements: 



> At least 2 years of experience in health writing, medical journalism, science writing, journalism, blogging, or digital publishing

> Strong English writing and grammar skills

> Good understanding of health, medicine, science, wellness, nutrition, and public health topics

> Strong ability to research and interpret medical and scientific information

> Ability to quickly identify newsworthy health stories and angles that are relevant to readers

> Skilled in researching and verifying information using credible medical, scientific, academic, government, and news sources

> Must have an active Reddit account

> Must have a good understanding of how Reddit works, including subreddits, discussions, comments, upvotes, and trending topics

> Must be comfortable monitoring and participating in relevant Reddit communities

> Must be able to post on Reddit and understand how to engage appropriately with relevant communities

> Ability to independently verify information discovered on Reddit before using it in an article

> Understanding of the importance of responsible reporting when covering medical conditions, treatments, medications, and health claims

> Ability to simplify complex medical and scientific topics into clear, reader-friendly content without losing accuracy

> Comfortable covering breaking news and fast-moving health and science developments

> Able to work independently and manage daily article production

> Experience with online publishing platforms or CMS is a plus



What We're Looking For:



> Strong interest in health, medicine, science, and current affairs

> Excellent research and fact-checking skills

> Strong understanding of evidence-based journalism

> Strong headline writing skills with a focus on CTR without sensationalising medical information

> Ability to spot emerging health stories and trends before they become mainstream

> Ability to identify interesting angles from Reddit, social media, research papers, and breaking news

> Good editorial judgment when handling sensitive medical and health-related topics

> Accuracy and attention to detail

> Fast turnaround without sacrificing quality

> Ability to write for a general audience rather than using overly technical medical language

> Consistency, reliability, and self-discipline

> Ability to work independently with minimal supervision



Ideal Candidate Profile



You are someone who:



> Follows health, medical, scientific, and public health news daily

> Understands how medical developments and research can affect everyday people

> Can quickly identify interesting stories from studies, expert commentary, breaking news, Reddit, and social media

> Knows how to distinguish credible medical information from misinformation, speculation, and anecdotal claims

> Can turn complex research into clear and engaging articles

> Understands that health journalism requires accuracy, context, and responsible reporting

> Writes with clarity, authority, and purpose — not fluff



Preferred Qualifications:



> Experience writing for health, medical, science, wellness, lifestyle, or news publications

> Degree or educational background in journalism, communications, health sciences, medicine, science, or a related field is a plus

> Experience covering medical research, clinical studies, NHS topics, public health, or healthcare developments

> Active or established Reddit account with familiarity across relevant health, science, medical, wellness, or lifestyle subreddits

> Experience finding story ideas through Reddit, social media, research databases, and online communities

> Knowledge of SEO and digital publishing best practices

> Familiarity with Google Trends and other news discovery tools





If you’re passionate about health, medicine, science, wellness, and current affairs — and can consistently deliver accurate, engaging, well-researched content while maintaining responsible editorial standards — we’d love to hear from you.

title: Hands-On Digital Marketing & Content Manager – Luxury Real Estate
description:
ABOUT PACIFIC ISLAND PARTNERS



Pacific Island Partners is a Maui-based luxury real estate team affiliated with Coldwell Banker Island Properties. We combine deep local market knowledge with experience in luxury real estate, property development, branding and storytelling to represent distinctive properties across Maui and the Hawaiian Islands.



Our business is growing, with an expanding portfolio of clients and sophisticated property-marketing assignments. We are building a modern marketing operation that combines exceptional creative work with digital advertising, social media, content,
, SEO, technology and direct audience outreach.



We are looking for a long-term team member—not simply someone to complete a single campaign. The right person will become familiar with our brand and clients, take ownership of day-to-day digital delivery and help us continually improve how we market exceptional properties.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a highly capable, hands-on Digital Marketing & Content Manager based in the Philippines who can turn strategic direction and premium creative assets into completed, published and measurable campaigns.



This is not a strategy-only, account-management or project-coordination role. You will personally create, build, publish, test and optimize the majority of our day-to-day digital marketing. You will work directly with the CMO, who will provide campaign direction and final approvals. Our existing marketing team will support major creative production, public relations, brochures and premium print materials.



WHAT YOU WILL PERSONALLY CREATE AND DELIVER



• Social media and LinkedIn posts, captions, carousels and short-form content

• Content calendars and coordinated multichannel campaign launches

• Landing pages, lead forms and mobile-friendly inquiry experiences

•
 campaigns, newsletters and automated follow-up sequences

• Canva-level graphics and basic short-form video edits

• Organic social publishing, scheduling and community management

• LinkedIn, Meta and selected Google advertising campaigns

• On-page SEO, metadata, internal links and website content updates

• CRM segmentation, lead routing, tagging and basic automations

• Tracking links, conversion events, testing and weekly reporting

• Repurposing hero photography, video, editorial and brochure content into digital formats

• Coordination with our PR, design, print and specialist partners when required



INITIAL CAMPAIGN



One of your first projects will support the relaunch of an exceptional Maui estate. The campaign combines highly personalized physical outreach to a limited group of business leaders with a much broader digital program intended to reach thousands of relevant executives, entrepreneurs, investors, advisers and prospective buyers.



You will help build the landing experience, digital content, LinkedIn and social campaigns,
 sequences, advertising, CRM follow-up and measurement. Accuracy, discretion and high-quality presentation are essential.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• At least three years of hands-on digital marketing experience

• Strong written English and the ability to write natural, polished U.S. English

• Demonstrated social media and LinkedIn content creation

• Experience building landing pages using platforms such as WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow, GoHighLevel or similar

• Experience creating and testing
 campaigns and automations

• Strong Canva skills and basic short-form video editing

• Working knowledge of Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and/or Google Ads

• Practical on-page SEO and website publishing experience

• Experience with analytics, tracking and performance reporting

• Strong organization, attention to detail and independent follow-through

• Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity while fact-checking all output



Luxury, real estate, hospitality, B2B or executive-audience marketing experience is valuable but not required. Good judgment and the quality of your work matter more than industry labels.



WORKING ARRANGEMENTS



• Full-time remote position based in the Philippines

• 40 hours per week

• Philippine daytime working hours are acceptable

• Availability for a scheduled daily overlap of approximately one hour, generally around 3:00–4:00 p.m. Hawaii time / 9:00–10:00 a.m. Philippine time the following day

• Regular communication with the CMO and dependable attendance during agreed hours



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



Success is measured by completed and published work—not by plans, meetings or tasks assigned to other people. Each week, you should be able to show what you created, launched, tested, improved and delivered.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short explanation of why this hands-on role fits you.

2. Links to three relevant examples of work you personally created.

3. One landing page you personally built.

4. One
 campaign or automated sequence you personally created.

5. Examples of social or LinkedIn content, including graphics or video.

6. Details of any paid campaigns you personally managed, including budget and results.

7. A clear explanation of what you created yourself and what was produced by other team members.

8. Your expected monthly salary and your availability.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid practical exercise. We are looking for a dependable long-term team member who combines creativity, technical execution and personal accountability.

title: SOCIAL MEDIA GROWTH, CONVERSION & REVENUE INTELLIGENCE LEAD
description:
Part-Time | Remote | High-Priority Position



We are seeking an experienced, performance-driven professional who can connect social media growth, campaign execution, lead conversion, and revenue intelligence.



This is not a traditional social media management position.



The person selected will be responsible for getting content in front of the right audiences, turning attention into qualified leads and sales, and identifying the truth behind campaign and revenue performance.



We need someone who can confidently answer:



Who engaged?

Who responded?

Who became a lead?

Who purchased?

What worked?

What failed?

Where are we losing revenue?

What needs to change?



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



Social Media Growth & Conversion



* Develop and execute organic audience-growth strategies

* Create social media growth and conversion strategies

* Build campaign and promotional calendars

* Lead content strategy and campaign distribution

* Generate qualified traffic and ticket-funnel entry

* Develop speaker promotional campaigns

* Coordinate affiliate amplification strategies

* Turn engagement, conversations, and audience attention into leads

* Monitor conversations, follow-ups, lead activity, and conversions

* Conduct campaign testing and recommend improvements

* Develop paid-media strategies when approved

* Use GoHighLevel to support marketing, lead tracking, and conversion activities



Revenue Performance & Process Intelligence



* Analyze KPIs and revenue reports

* Evaluate funnel and campaign performance

* Track conversion rates throughout the customer journey

* Audit pipeline quality

* Analyze lead sources and buyer behavior

* Identify revenue leakage and process failures

* Conduct root-cause analysis

* Evaluate team performance trends

* Recommend corrective actions

* Test whether corrective actions produced measurable improvement

* Report what is actually happening—not what the team assumes is happening

* Present clear, evidence-based findings and recommendations to leadership



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Applicants must demonstrate proven experience in:



* Social media growth and organic audience acquisition

* Lead generation and conversion

* Campaign strategy and execution

* Funnel and pipeline analysis

* KPI and revenue-performance reporting

* GoHighLevel or comparable CRM and marketing automation platforms

* Campaign analytics and attribution

* Managing projects, priorities, and performance outcomes

* Leading through ownership, sound judgment, and accountability



This position requires significant front-end revenue visibility. The selected candidate will work with social and marketing tools, conversations, contacts, communities, opportunities, forms, calendars, dashboards, campaigns, and relevant conversion data. This access is provided for performance and accountability—not backend administrative control.



WHO SHOULD APPLY



Apply if you:



* Have proven management or ownership-level skills

* Can work independently without waiting for step-by-step instructions

* Understand the relationship between content, traffic, leads, pipeline, and revenue

* Can interpret data and explain what it means in clear language

* Know how to identify problems and recommend practical solutions

* Are comfortable being held accountable for measurable growth and conversion results

* Communicate professionally, directly, and consistently

* Can manage high-priority work in a fast-moving environment



DO NOT APPLY IF:



* You are seeking entry-level training

* Your primary qualification is that you are a “fast learner”

* You rely on being “adaptable” as a substitute for demonstrated experience

* Your experience is limited to posting content or creating graphics

* You cannot provide examples of measurable growth, lead-generation, conversion, or revenue results

* You require continuous supervision to complete your responsibilities



EMPLOYMENT STRUCTURE



* Part-time position

* Probationary period required

* Continued employment and opportunities for growth will be based on production, performance, ownership, communication, and compliance with probationary guidelines

* All applicant skills and stated experience will be tested

* This is a high-priority opening



HOW TO APPLY



All inquiries and applications must be professional.



Please submit:



1. Your résumé

2. A brief explanation of your relevant experience

3. Examples of campaigns you have managed

4. Measurable results involving audience growth, leads, conversions, pipeline, ticket sales, or revenue

5. Your GoHighLevel experience and the specific features you have used

6. An example of a performance problem you identified, what you recommended, and whether the corrective action worked

7. Your desired hourly rate

8. Your weekly availability and time zone



Generic, incomplete, or unprofessional applications will not be considered. Applicants who pass the initial review will complete a practical skills assessment before advancing.

title: Business Operations Manager | Revenue, Systems & Execution
description:
A small, established U.S. services company is hiring a full-time operator in the Philippines to make the business run with greater clarity, follow-through, and discipline.



We serve customers through several physical locations and a substantial remote program. We also work with international partners and are building internal software to replace fragmented tools and make the operation easier to manage. We are keeping the company name private in the public advertisement and will share it with selected interview candidates.



This is an operating seat, not an executive-assistant queue and not a CFO or controller position. You will work directly with the founder, but you will not wait for a daily task list. Your job is to understand how customers, money, work, and commitments move through the company, identify what is stuck or unclear, and bring it to a responsible conclusion.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Maintain one dependable view of customer status, open opportunities, onboarding, delivery, billing, receivables, risks, owners, and next actions.

- Pursue loose ends with customers, staff, partners, and vendors until each item is resolved, deliberately deferred, or escalated with a recommendation.

- Make sure inquiries, purchases, renewals, refunds, billing questions, and collection items do not disappear between systems or people.

- Prepare a short weekly founder brief covering cash, expected receipts, urgent obligations, customer risks, decisions, and unresolved exceptions.

- Keep the operating cash calendar current, including expected receipts, invoices, rent, payroll inputs, recurring bills, and unusual commitments.

- Perform light bookkeeping and finance operations: review invoice support, track AP and AR, match payments to customers or invoices, code straightforward expenses, perform basic reconciliations, investigate exceptions, and keep documentation organized.

- Coordinate with the bookkeeper, controller, payroll provider, and tax professional. You are not expected to replace technical specialists, but you are expected to give them complete records, ask good questions, and follow their open items to completion.

- Build practical SOPs, checklists, dashboards, escalation rules, and handoffs after you understand the real work.

- Become a serious daily user of our emerging internal operating platform. Identify missing states, controls, reports, and automations, test improvements, and explain what the system needs to support the business.

- Lead or coordinate additional support later when the workload justifies it. The role begins hands-on.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



- It is not calendar management, inbox triage, or a collection of unrelated assistant tasks.

- It is not a pure project-management role where updating the board counts as finishing the work.

- It is not a senior-finance title that delegates all transaction-level work.

- It is not the sole technical accounting seat. Historical cleanup, formal close, tax work, and complex accounting remain with qualified specialists.



FIRST 30 DAYS

By day 30, the successful operator will have:

- Produced a clear operating map of customers, revenue flows, recurring obligations, systems, access needs, owners, and unresolved risks.

- Established and consistently used one follow-through system plus a concise founder communication rhythm.

- Completed a books and finance-operations diagnostic, organized the available support, resolved routine discrepancies within the role’s scope, and created an owner, priority, and target-date plan for specialist items.

- Documented at least three high-priority SOPs selected with the founder and created a practical improvement backlog.



Success does not mean that every inherited problem must be solved in 30 days. It means demonstrated ownership, useful discovery, dependable communication, sound escalation, and concrete progress on these outcomes.



WHAT STRONG EVIDENCE LOOKS LIKE



- At least five years in business operations, customer operations, revenue operations, practice or agency operations, account management, implementation, project operations, or a comparable role with real ownership.

- A history of personally rescuing stalled work, revenue, customer commitments, or cross-team projects and changing the process so the same failure became less likely.

- Clear spoken and written English with U.S. customers and a founder.

- Comfort with CRM, billing, task, documentation, spreadsheet, and automation tools. Experience with QuickBooks Online, Xero, Stripe, or similar systems is useful.

- Enough bookkeeping fluency to follow an invoice or payment from source record through the books, find a mismatch, and know when to involve an accountant.

- Good judgment with customer, employee, and financial information.

- The ability to give a concise recommendation when facts are incomplete, distinguish an assumption from a fact, and escalate early when risk is material.

- Interest in one primary, long-term operating role rather than adding another client to a crowded schedule.



No CPA is required. We care more about personally owned outcomes, clear mechanics, and trustworthy judgment than titles or polished generalities.



PRACTICAL ARRANGEMENT



- Full-time primary commitment: 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday

- Eight consistent working hours per day

- At least five consecutive hours must fall between 7:00 AM and 7:00 PM U.S. Pacific and remain on the Pacific clock when daylight-saving time changes

- Compensation: PHP 100,000 per month during a paid 30-day initial performance period. Beginning on day 31, compensation becomes PHP 120,000 per month if employment continues and the stated first-month outcomes have been met, plus 13th-month pay

- Long-term remote position in the Philippines

- Company identity shared with selected interview candidates

- References and a paid, controlled work simulation may be requested only at a later stage



HOW TO APPLY



Start your reply with OWN THE OUTCOME and answer these four questions. Do not include confidential customer or employer information.



1. Describe one messy business situation that crossed people or departments and had no clear owner. What was stuck, what systems or records did you use, what did you d
 and do personally, and what measurable result followed?

2. Describe one customer, billing, collection, renewal, or revenue item that would have been lost without your follow-through. How did you find it, who did you involve, and how did you close it?

3. What bookkeeping or finance-operations work have you personally performed? Name the tools, records, and exact scope. Include one payment, invoice, AP/AR, cash, or reconciliation mismatch you investigated, and be clear about what an accountant or another team member handled.

4. List all current jobs, clients, businesses, and recurring obligations with weekly hours. Then state the exact eight-hour Pacific-time schedule you would work, your earliest start date, and whether you accept PHP 100,000 for the first 30 days and PHP 120,000 beginning day 31 after successful completion of the initial performance period and can later provide two professional references.



Never send passwords, credentials, unredacted financial records, or confidential customer data.

title: VIDEO EDITING - Rough Cut Editor for IRL Travel Stream Videos (Recurring)
description:
SCOPE OF WORK (GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION)



EDITOR needed to refine rough cuts for a large English-speaking IRL travel streamer. We make the first rough cut and organize all the footage. Your job is to make the video flow.



Your outcome is to:

1. Open our project file and review the rough timeline.

2. Fix the cut points so every scene starts and ends at the right moment.

3. Tighten or remove slow sections so the video plays smoothly from start to finish.



Success is a timeline that flows naturally and is ready for our finishing team. You will not build the video from scratch. You will not add graphics, captions, translations, or title cards. We do those.



KEY BULLET POINTS



- Required: You edit in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Tell us which one you use.

- Required: You understand spoken English very well, including fast talking and slang.

- Required: You are comfortable cutting scenes where people speak languages you do not know (some scenes have Mandarin).

- Required: Fast, stable internet. You will download large video files for every job.

- Required: You can return a finished timeline within 2 days of receiving the project.

- Ideal: You already watch IRL or travel streamers.

- Ideal: You have edited long videos (30 to 60 minutes) before.

- Ideal: You understand some Chinese (Mandarin). You do not need to be fluent.



OVERVIEW AND DETAILS



The streamer walks around cities in Asia (Japan, Korea, China), eats street food, meets people, and talks with his chat. The videos are dialogue-heavy. We (Hansei GG) produce his YouTube videos. Our team makes the rough cut and puts all footage into labeled bins by chapter. You are the pass in the middle: fix the boundaries, make it flow. After you, our team adds the polish.



Good fit: Editors who care about story, pacing, and clean cuts.

Bad fit: Motion graphics artists looking for effects work. Editors who want full creative control.



EXAMPLES OF FIXES WE EXPECT



- Good: The scene starts right as the story begins, not 20 seconds before.

- Good: A conversation ends on the punchline, then cuts to the next scene.

- Bad: A scene starts in the middle of a sentence.

- Bad: 30 seconds of silent walking left between two stories.



EDITING DETAILS



For each video you receive: a project file, the rough-cut timeline, and footage organized into bins labeled by chapter. You adjust cut points, trim or remove sections, and smooth the audio at each cut so it does not pop. You return the same project file with the timeline fixed. Keep all bins and file names as they are.



PAY



Rate: $8/hr USD, tracked. Paid by PayPal after each video is approved. Rate agreed in writing before your first paid job. No payment before work is delivered.



TO APPLY



Send an
 to 
 with the TITLE: "IRL Rough Cut Editor Application - Your Name"



INCLUDE:

- Start your message with the word FLOW.

- The test. Watch this short clip: 
 Reply with three things: 1) the timestamp where the scene should start, 2) the timestamp where it should end, 3) one part you would cut out, with start and end timestamps. Add one short sentence explaining each choice. This is the most important part of the application.

- One or two sentences about your editing experience. A portfolio link is welcome but not required.

- Which software you use (Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve) and your timezone.

- Confirm you can receive PayPal payments.



If your test answers are good, we hire you and you start on your first paid video right away.



We will NOT consider:

- Applications with the wrong title or missing the word FLOW.

- Applications without the test answers.

- Any AI-written submissions.



Thank you!

title: AI Content & WordPress Virtual Assistant – Product Reviews
description:
AI Content & WordPress Virtual Assistant – Product Reviews



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help research, create, edit, and publish product-review content for an established product review website.



This is not a traditional freelance writing position.



We have developed a detailed production process that includes step-by-step SOPs, standardized AI prompts, research guidelines, WordPress procedures, SEO requirements, image standards, and completed examples.



Your job will be to follow this system carefully and produce accurate, well-formatted product reviews.



What You Will Do

Research assigned products and verify the exact model and specifications

Collect product information and relevant customer feedback

Organize research into a standardized source package

Use our approved ChatGPT prompts to generate review drafts

Fact-check AI-generated content against the original research

Edit content for clarity, accuracy, and natural language

Create standardized product images using AI tools

Prepare images for the web

Build and format review posts in WordPress

Configure review ratings, Pros & Cons, and review summaries

Add and verify Amazon affiliate links

Perform basic Rank Math SEO optimization

Add relevant internal links

Configure Product schema using our documented procedure

Check structured data and page formatting

Preview posts on desktop and mobile

Complete a final quality-control checklist

What We're Looking For



You should be:



Extremely detail-oriented

Comfortable following detailed written instructions

Able to research information carefully rather than guessing

Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools

Familiar with WordPress

Able to write and edit clear English

Familiar with basic SEO concepts

Comfortable learning new WordPress plugins and tools

Willing to ask questions when something is unclear rather than making unsupported assumptions



Native-level English is not required, but you should have strong written English comprehension.



Previous product-review experience is helpful but not required.



Important: AI Is a Tool, Not the Final Authority



We use AI extensively in our production process.



However, this job is not simply copying information into ChatGPT and publishing whatever it produces.



You will be responsible for comparing AI-generated content against the supplied research, identifying unsupported statements or mistakes, and correcting them before the article is submitted.



Accuracy is more important than filling space.



Training & Documentation



You will receive detailed materials including:



Product Review Production SOP

Standard AI Prompt Pack

Resources & Tools Guide

Completed example product review

Example product research/source package

WordPress training/sandbox environment



You will be able to inspect a completed review in WordPress to see exactly how a finished article should be constructed.



Paid Test



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid practical test.



The test will involve researching and creating a real product-review draft using the same process you would use after being hired.



You will receive the necessary instructions, templates, prompts, and access to our training WordPress site.



We do not expect applicants to purchase software or a paid AI subscription to complete the test.



Hours



This is a part-time position for up to 10 hours per week initially. Workload may vary depending on the number of review assignments available.



There is potential for additional work and responsibility for someone who consistently produces accurate work and follows the production process well.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words:



Ready to Review



This lets us know you read the complete job description.



Then answer the following questions:



Describe your experience working with WordPress. What types of posts or websites have you worked on?

How do you currently use ChatGPT or other AI tools when creating or editing content?

Imagine you are reviewing a watch and Amazon says it is water resistant to 50 meters, but another website says 100 meters. How would you determine which specification to use?

What are some signs that an AI-generated article needs additional editing or fact-checking?

If our written SOP tells you to do something but you believe the instruction may be incorrect for the particular product you're working on, what would you do?

Please provide links to, or briefly describe, one or two examples of relevant work you have completed. If you do not have examples, that's okay; tell us about the closest type of work you've done.



Please do not use AI to write your answers to these questions. We aren't judging perfect grammar. We want to understand how you think and communicate.
