title: Short-Form Video Editor + Content Manager
description:
I'm a relationship therapist and content creator looking for a talented short-form video editor/content manager to work with me long-term.



Editing and storytelling are the most important parts of this role. I'm not looking for someone who simply adds captions and transitions. I need someone who can understand what I'm saying, identify the strongest idea, and turn raw footage into compelling content.



THE EDITING:

A big part of this role will be what I call “yap editing.” I may send you 3–5 minutes of unscripted talking-head footage with little direction. Your job is to find the best content inside it:

*Identify the strongest hook, even if it's buried halfway through the footage

*Cut filler, repetition and tangents

*Rearrange footage when needed to create a stronger story

*Build pacing and keep the viewer interested

*Add clean, modern captions

*Overlay relevant B-roll, photos, text, graphics, stickers, screenshots, etc. when they strengthen the point

*Edit for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

*Choose/create an aesthetic cover for each reel

*I want the editing to feel intentional and creative, not overproduced. Visuals should strengthen what I'm saying rather than distract from it*



ENGLISH COMPREHENSION IS VERY IMPORTANT

*My content is about relationships, psychology and human behavior, so understanding the meaning and nuance of what I'm saying is essential.

*You need to be able to listen to several minutes of unscripted footage and recognize:

-What's the actual point?

-What's the most interesting sentence?

-What can be used to hook in the viewer?

-What would make someone stop scrolling?

-What can we cut without losing the meaning?

*Excellent English comprehension is therefore a major requirement for this position*



CONTENT MANAGEMENT

I'm also looking for someone who can help me turn content creation into a consistent system.

*Use my library of photos/videos to create B-roll, carousels and other content

*Schedule and publish content across platforms using Metricool

*Maintain a content calendar

*Keep track of what's ready, what's scheduled and what we need next

*Proactively ask me for copy, footage, photos or anything else you need to keep content going

----- I actually want you to keep ME accountable. If you need copy from me by Tuesday to get Thursday's post out, ask me for it. If we're running low on videos, tell me it's time to film-----

----- I don't want to constantly create assignments for you. As we work together, I'd love for you to increasingly own the content workflow while I focus on creating-----



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

*Excellent short-form video editing portfolio

*Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing and retention

*Excellent English comprehension

*Great visual taste and ability to adapt to a specific editing style

*Comfortable with Canva + video editing software

*Proactive, organized and dependable

*Comfortable using or learning Metricool

*Able to take feedback and refine an editing style until we nail it

*Interested in a long-term working relationship



-----Part-time: approximately 15–20 hours/week to start with opportunity to grow

-----Pay: $6–8 USD/hour depending on experience with opportunity for increased pay as role grows



TO APPLY PLEASE SEND:

*Your portfolio and 3 short-form videos you're most proud of

*Briefly tell me what you were responsible for on those videos (Were you given a finished script/direction, or did you help shape the content?)

*A carousel/graphic example if you have one

*What editing software you use

*Your hourly rate and availability

*A brief description of your social media/content management experience

*Tell me how you d
 what the hook should be when you're given a longer, unscripted talking-head video.

*Are you comfortable proactively managing a content calendar and asking me for what you need to keep posts on schedule?



Please put YAP at the beginning of your application so I know you read the full post. Please answer the questions in your own words rather than sending AI-generated application. 



Finalists will be invited to complete a short paid test edit.

title: Operations Execution Coordinator
description:
Operations Execution Lead  

Compensation: $1,400/month  



Mission  

Turn priorities into finished results.  



SteelSafe operates self-storage properties across the United States. There is always work that needs to get done: property issues, vendors, purchases, projects, recurring operations, and problems that cross multiple people or systems.   



Your job is to own that execution.  



Some work you will do yourself. Some you will delegate to team members, boots on the ground, or vendors.  



Either way, you own the result.  



When leadership hands you an outcome, we should be able to forget about it until you come back with the finished result.  





Operating Rules  

Own the result. Do not pass problems.   

Assigning is not completing. Delegated work is still your responsibility.   

Asana is the system of record. If it is not in Asana, it does not exist.   

No proof = not done.   

Move fast. Small problems get expensive when they sit.   

No silent failures. Surface risks early with a recovery plan.   

Bring solutions. If leadership must d
, bring the options and your recommendation.   

Close loops. Nobody should have to ask, “Whatever happened with that?”   

Build better systems. The better you get, the less time the same work should require.   



What You Own  



1. Property & Rent-Ready Execution   



Drive property work from problem to verified completion.   



Examples:   

Get unavailable units back to Rent-Ready.   

Coordinate cleanouts.   

Get doors, locks, leaks, roofs, gates, cameras, fencing, weeds, trash, signs, electrical issues, and other property problems resolved.   

Coordinate vendors, quotes, scheduling, execution, and proof.   



The process is: Problem → Owner → Quote → Approval if needed → Schedule → Execute → Verify → Close    



Every unavailable unit must have a reason, owner, next action, and deadline.   



Do not report that a unit is stuck.   



Get it unstuck.  



2. BOTG & Vendor Management  



Own the people who execute work locally.  

Find and hire BOTG and vendors.  

Give clear scopes and deadlines.   

Get quotes.   

Follow up.   

Verify work.  

Correct poor work.  

Replace underperformers.   

Maintain backup options.  



 “I asked them” is not a result.  



The work being completed correctly is the result.  



3. Projects & Procurement  



Own independent projects from idea to completion.  



Examples include:  

Source and purchase supplies or equipment.  

Order signs, locks, parts, cameras, and materials.  

Research and negotiate vendors or services.  

Sell unused assets.  

Coordinate property improvement projects.  

Build new operational processes.  

Complete one-off projects leadership assigns.  



You are expected to figure out the path forward without needing step-by-step direction.  



4. Operational Problem Resolution  



When a customer or company issue requires operational action, own the execution.  



Investigate the problem, determine what needs to happen, coordinate the people involved, and drive it through resolution.  



Leadership owns unusual policy, legal, financial, or strategic decisions.  



Once the decision is made, you own getting it done.  

  



What Winning Looks Like  

Work gets completed on time.  

Projects do not stall.  

Rent-Ready units do not sit because nobody followed through.  

Vendors and BOTG are held accountable.  

Problems are surfaced before deadlines are missed.  

Completed work is actually complete.  

Asana reflects reality.  

Recurring work becomes simpler and requires less manual effort.  



This Role Is a Fit If You  

Are a doer.  

Take ownership without reminders.  

Finish what you start.  

Can manage a small team and still execute personally.  

Can take an unfamiliar project and figure it out.  

Follow up relentlessly.  

Make good decisions independently.  

Keep many moving pieces organized.  

Communicate problems early.  

Hold vendors and teammates accountable.  

Care about details and proof.  

Enjoy turning messy work into reliable systems.  



Own the result, not the clock. Do what it takes to get the job done. Then improve the system so the same result takes less time and effort next time.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor — Beauty / Wellness / Lifestyle
description:
Hi! I’m looking for a long-term video editor for my growing YouTube channel, The Glow Trials.

The channel focuses on beauty, wellness, skincare, self-experiments, and research-based “glow-up” content. Videos combine personal storytelling with before/afters, experiments, scientific research, and lifestyle footage.

I’m looking for someone who can grow with the channel and eventually become my regular editor.



Workload

Approximately 8 long-form videos per month

Usually 15–25 minutes finished

Occasionally longer videos

Consistent ongoing work for the right person

All videos delivered in 4K / 3840×2160

Starting Budget $50 per standard video / approximately $400 per month for 8 videos

I’m open to increasing this toward $600/month as we establish a good workflow and depending on editing quality, complexity, and consistency.

I’m looking for a long-term relationship rather than a one-time project.



What I Need From You

I will send you the raw talking-head footage.

I don't want to make a rough cut myself first.

The raw footage may contain:

repeated takes

mistakes

pauses

tangents

sections that need to be shortened

multiple versions of the same sentence

You should be comfortable watching the raw footage, choosing the strongest takes, removing unnecessary material while keeping funny/personality moments and creating a well-paced story.

A 20-minute finished video may come from significantly more raw footage.



You would also handle:

Cutting and tightening talking-head footage

B-roll and appropriate stock footage

Screenshots and research visuals

Motion graphics

Text callouts

Punch-ins / zooms when appropriate

Music and sound effects

Before/after photos and comparison visuals

Final 4K export

I will provide any personal footage, experiment footage, before/after photos, research documents, and specific assets that are necessary.



Editing Style

The style should feel:

Clean · Feminine · personable · Polished · Pretty

I want engaging editing, but I do not want hyperactive editing with constant effects, meme inserts, excessive captions, or unnecessary transitions. (some fun stuff is good)

The editing should support the story rather than distract from it.

Think polished beauty/wellness/lifestyle YouTube rather than gaming or MrBeast-style editing.



Very Important:

Because you will be editing my raw talking-head footage, strong English comprehension is required.

You need to understand what I am saying well enough to decide:

which take is strongest

what information is repetitive

what can be removed

what needs to stay for the story to make sense

You should also have reliable enough internet and computer hardware to download and edit large 4K video files.



To Apply

Please include:

2–3 examples of long-form YouTube videos you personally edited.

If possible, please include an example involving:

a female creator

beauty

skincare

wellness

lifestyle

personal-brand content

or talking-head storytelling

Tell me whether you were responsible for editing the raw footage down yourself in those examples or whether the creator supplied you with a rough cut.



Are you able to edit and export in 4K (3840×2160)?

Approximately how much raw talking-head footage would you be comfortable working from for a 20-minute finished video at this rate?



Paid Test!

I plan to select a few promising applicants for a paid test edit before choosing my long-term editor.

If you have a good eye for YouTube storytelling and want consistent long-term work with a growing channel, I’d love to see your portfolio!

title: Property Manager / Operations Manager / Project Manager for Property Management Company
description:
Can you take a problem you've never seen before and figure out how to solve it? That's the person we're looking for.



We manage a growing portfolio of long-term residential and commercial rental properties in Minnesota. We need a resourceful, organized operator to take ownership of day-to-day operations: someone who thinks a step ahead, closes the loop, and makes sure work moves from "reported" to "done" without being chased.



We care more about how you think than about your exact job history. Some of our best people have come from executive assistant, operations, and hospitality backgrounds, not just property management. If you're sharp, organized, and a fast learner, we'll teach you our systems. We are not looking for a simple task-doer; we want someone who can be given a problem, think through the steps needed to solve it, and come back with the resources and solutions to do so.



**Growth-Minded & Solutions-Focused:** We don't dwell on problems; we find solutions. We want people who are hungry to learn, grow, and improve our systems every day.



**Positive Energy:** Property management sometimes involves surprise challenges. Pipes burst, tenants stop paying. It is critical that we approach our work with a positive attitude. We value collaboration, open communication, and a "can-do" spirit.



**A Relationship, Not a Transaction:** We want a years-long partnership where you feel supported, trusted, and empowered to make decisions.



**Impact Over Activity:** We value outcomes. You won't be micromanaged; you will be given clear goals and the freedom to execute, along with the support to be able to succeed.



This role will be 40 hours per week, once fully trained. Your compensation will reflect your experience, initiative, growth, and contribution to the business's success.



**Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 10:00AM to 6:00PM US Eastern time. These hours exist so you can reach US contractors, tenants, and agencies during their business day.



**What you'd own:**



**Operations (60%):**

The "Loop-Closer": When a task comes in, you manage the communication, the schedule, and the reporting in 
 and in daily report-outs to the team. Your job is to make sure work moves from "reported" to "fully completed" as efficiently as possible, and that everyone involved has what they need to do their jobs.



Tenant communication, coordinating repairs and vendors, lease renewals and lease compliance, rent tracking and follow-up on outstanding balances, coordinating with housing assistance agencies, preparing eviction documentation when needed, move-in and move-out procedures and inspections, and keeping everything moving in 
.



**Systems and finance (20%):** You are confident with numbers, bookkeeping software, and general bookkeeping. You coordinate with our accountant to ensure any questions they have are answered so our books stay accurate. You support the build of new systems and initiatives, as well as handling invoices, expense tracking, owner statements, paying invoices, updating tenant ledgers, and working within our financial SOPs.



**Communication (20%):** Warm, calm, and professional with tenants, contractors, and owners. You respond promptly, warmly, and correctly to tenant maintenance requests and contractor messages. You know how to present yourself in a warm, calm, professional manner no matter the situation, including when a conversation is difficult.



You'll thrive here if you're proactive and detail-oriented, comfortable making decisions without being micromanaged, hungry to learn, and looking for a long-term partnership rather than a transaction.



**Must have:** reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, and comfort working US hours.



**ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS:**



3+ Years working in a US-Based Business with operations responsibility.



**Fluency in English:** Confident in multi-person meetings, initiating phone calls, and in non-scripted situations in English.



**The "Loop-Closer" DNA:** You live by the 24-hour no-update rule. If a project is open, you provide an update before we have to ask.



**Comfortable with Numbers:** You can categorize expenses accurately and notice when a figure doesn't look right. Formal bookkeeping experience is a plus, not a requirement.



**Highly Detail-Oriented and Organized:** Able to track tasks across multiple properties and follow up on outstanding issues. Skilled at prioritizing tasks based on urgency and importance.



You have a positive growth mindset.



**Strong communication skills:** you are a proactive communicator who doesn't wait to be asked for updates. You're eager to participate in ongoing discussions about improving communication protocols and systems, and receptive to feedback.



**The Tech Stack:** While we use REIhub and 
, we value your property management and accounting experience over your specific software experience. If you are an expert in the industry and familiar with competitor tools (Innago, AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi), we can train you on our specific stack.



**MUST HAVE reliable internet connection with backup.**



Proficiency with Google Drive, WhatsApp, and ability to quickly learn 
.



**A note on AI:** we use it too, so use whatever tools help you. We ask one thing in return: be straight about what you've actually done and how you actually communicate.



**HOW TO APPLY:**



To verify your attention to detail, please follow these steps exactly:



**Subject Line:** Include the name of the original bass player for the Grateful Dead.



**Cover Letter (Paragraph 3):** Include the phrase "closing the loop."



In your response, confirm you are available for the days and times described in this position.



Please answer the following questions in your cover letter:

1) Describe a specific time you solved a contractor or tenant problem without waiting for direction. How did it start, what steps did you take, how was it resolved?



2) A tenant in Hutchinson, Minnesota reports on a Tuesday morning that their furnace has stopped working. You have never worked in that town, you have no vendor list there, and I am not available. Walk me through exactly what you do: how you find contractors, how you d
 which ones are legitimate, how you handle quotes, and how you get someone scheduled by Friday.



3) At any moment you'll have multiple open items running across different properties, say a repair waiting on a contractor, a tenant who owes rent, and a move-out inspection all live at once. Two things: (1) What system or tools do you personally use to track these so nothing slips and everyone gets an update before they have to ask? (2) When you can't get to everything, how do you d
 what comes first? Give a real example that shows both in action.



4) If your past experience is not in property management, how does it set you up for success in this role?



**AI:** Tell us two things: how you used AI to put this application together, and how you'd use it in the day-to-day of this role.



Please include a resume or summary of your background. Also name ONE reference from a role like this one: their name, their role, and their company. We will ask for their contact information later if we move forward. Video introductions are welcome.

title: Linux Server admin (experienced) GIG
description:
Overview

A US-based technology services company is seeking an experienced Linux/DevOps professional to serve as a live technical advisor during the deployment of a pre-written Standard Operating Procedure (SOP). The SOP is already complete and contains ready-to-use, copy-paste code blocks. Your job is to remote in, watch the operator's screen in real time as they execute each step, answer questions as they arise, offer suggestions, and help catch anything that looks off before it becomes a problem.

This is not a hands-on-keyboard role. You are the expert in the room (virtually), guiding and validating the work as it's executed.

________________________________________

Work Arrangement

• Fully remote – you will join a live screen-share session (e.g., Zoom, Meet, or similar).

• Estimated total time: ~21 to 25 hours, broken into 7-8 scheduled sessions (not one marathon block). Could be faster because you are watching and talking to the user. 

• Flexible scheduling – sessions are coordinated in advance around mutual availability.

• 8   3 hours sessions you will be paid $125.00 after 3 sessions then 125.00 after four more sessions. Then after 25 hours you will get paid 9.00 USD per every extra hour. 

• 250.00 USD for 25 hours or less

• If it goes longer than 25 hours you will be paid 9.00 USD an hour each extra hour



________________________________________

What You'll Be Doing

• Watch the operator's screen as they work through the pre-written SOP, executing each copy-paste code block and configuration step.

• Answer technical questions in real time (e.g., "Is this the right flag for pg_dump?" or "Should this UFW rule come before or after that one?" or "This output looks different from what the SOP says—am I okay to continue?").

• Make suggestions where you see a safer, cleaner, or more efficient approach than what's in the SOP.

• Flag errors or unexpected outputs before they get locked in.

• Validate accuracy of commands, configurations, and outputs as each step is executed.

• Help troubleshoot if a code block doesn't behave as the SOP describes.

• Keep the tone collaborative – you're a trusted second set of eyes, not a micromanager.

________________________________________

Technical Areas Covered in the SOP (Your Expertise Should Span These)

Area What We Need You to Know

Linux Administration Ubuntu Server: users/permissions, systemd services, package management, cron, log analysis (journalctl, /var/log), resource troubleshooting (CPU/RAM/disk)

Docker & Docker Compose Deploy, update, restart, and debug multi-container stacks; read/write compose files; manage volumes and networks

PostgreSQL Routine admin: dumps/restores (pg_dump), user/role management, verifying backup integrity

Reverse Proxy & TLS Caddy or Nginx: virtual hosts, automatic HTTPS / Let's Encrypt renewal, redirect rules

Firewall & Hardening UFW/iptables, SSH key-only authentication, fail2ban, disabling root login, least-privilege user setup

Monitoring & Alerting Uptime Kuma (or Prometheus/Grafana): configuring checks, alert channels, status pages

Backups & Disaster Recovery Scripted backups (bash + cron), off-server copies (rsync/rclone/object storage), and actual restore drills

DNS Management A/CNAME records, TTLs, subdomains, nameserver changes (Cloudflare experience preferred)

Bash Scripting Write and maintain small maintenance/backup scripts; read and modify existing scripts safely

Git Clone, commit, push – all configuration changes tracked in a private repository

Documentation & English Clear written English; every step must be documented. "If it isn't documented, it didn't happen."

Nice to Have (Not Required)

• Experience with self-hosted workflow-automation tools

• Familiarity with transactional
 services and deliverability basics

• Familiarity with budget VPS providers (InterServer, Hetzner, DigitalOcean, Vultr)

• Basic understanding of webhook-based application integrations

________________________________________

What This Role Does NOT Include

• You are not writing or building the SOP – it's already done with copy-paste code blocks. You're advising while it's deployed.

• No independent server access – you observe the operator's session only.

________________________________________

How to Apply

Please include the following:

1. A 60–90 second voice recording: Introduce yourself, summarize your technical background, and explain which of the listed areas you're strongest in. Speak naturally – no scripts.

2. Proof of hands-on experience: GitHub profile, scripts, homelab write-up, or relevant certifications.

________________________________________

This is a focused, short-term advisory engagement. The SOP is written. The code blocks are ready. We just need a sharp, patient expert watching over the shoulder to make sure every step lands cleanly. If that sounds like your kind of afternoon, apply.

.

Storytelling and pacing

File organization

Communicating clearly in English

A strong portfolio, good judgment, creativity, reliability, and proven ability to create engaging content are more important than formal education.



Confidentiality Requirement

title: E-commerce Growth & Content Manager - Fashion Brand
description:
We are a growing modest fashion e-commerce brand looking for an experienced, creative and highly proactive E-commerce, Website & Social Media Growth Manager to work closely with the founder and take ownership of our digital growth.



We are currently a small/start-up brand in a growth and development stage and are looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term member of the business.



This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant role.



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to be given a list of tasks each day. We want someone who can understand our brand and customers, identify opportunities, bring ideas to the table, make recommendations and then execute them.

Your overall objective will be to help us increase brand awareness, grow our social-media presence, improve our website, drive qualified traffic and ultimately increase online sales.



The Role



You will take ownership of key areas of our online presence, including social media, content, our Shopify website, SEO,
 marketing and influencer outreach.

Social Media & Content

You will take an active role in developing our Instagram and TikTok strategy and identifying content opportunities that can help grow the brand.

We want someone who actively follows social-media trends and understands how to adapt them creatively for a fashion/e-commerce brand.

For example, rather than waiting for the founder to decide what to post, we want you to be able to say:

"This style of content is performing well right now. Here's how I think we should adapt it for the brand. Please film these 5–6 clips and send me the raw footage."

The founder can batch-film raw content based on your direction. You will then take it from there - editing, developing the hook, adding on-screen text, creating covers/graphics, writing captions and calls-to-action, scheduling/publishing and monitoring performance.

You will also create professional Canva graphics, carousels, Stories, infographics, promotional content and other digital marketing materials.

The aim is for you to lead the content process, rather than wait for the founder to continuously provide ideas.

Website, Shopify & Conversion

You will also take an active role in developing and improving our Shopify e-commerce website.

We want someone who regularly reviews the website from both a customer and commercial perspective and proactively identifies improvements.



This may include:

Improving the overall look and presentation of the website

Improving product and collection pages

Improving navigation and the customer journey

Product merchandising and presentation

Reviewing product descriptions and website copy

Improving mobile shopping experience

Identifying friction in the purchasing journey

Recommending and implementing conversion improvements

Creating landing pages or promotional pages when required

Keeping the website looking professional, current and consistent with the brand

Using analytics and customer behaviour to identify opportunities for improvement

The goal is not simply to maintain the website. We want you to help make it easier to discover, easier to shop and better at converting visitors into customers.

SEO & Organic Growth

You will work on improving our organic search visibility over time.



Responsibilities may include:



Keyword and competitor research

On-page SEO

Optimising product and collection pages

Improving page titles, meta descriptions and website copy

Identifying search opportunities relevant to our products

Developing SEO-friendly content where appropriate

Monitoring organic performance

Identifying technical or content-related SEO issues

Making ongoing recommendations to increase organic traffic

You do not necessarily need to be an advanced technical SEO specialist, but you should have practical e-commerce SEO experience and understand how to improve the organic visibility of a Shopify store.




 Marketing & Customer Retention

You will help develop our
-marketing strategy rather than only sending occasional promotional
s.

This may include:

Planning
 campaigns

Creating branded
 designs

Writing engaging
 copy

Product and promotional campaigns

Customer-retention
s

Developing and improving automated
 flows

Monitoring open rates, click-throughs, conversions and sales

Testing and improving campaigns based on performance

Influencer & UGC Growth

You will identify suitable influencers, micro-influencers and UGC creators who align with the brand and our target customer.

You will help:

Research potential creators

Manage outreach

Identify collaboration and gifting opportunities

Develop campaign ideas

Maintain relationships with creators

Track collaborations and results

Identify opportunities to repurpose UGC across our social media, website and advertising



Who We're Looking For



We are looking for someone with proven hands-on experience, rather than someone hoping to learn these skills for the first time.

Ideally, you will have previously worked with an e-commerce, fashion, beauty, lifestyle or female-focused consumer brand and can demonstrate the impact of your work.

You should have strong experience with:

Instagram and TikTok

Social-media growth and content strategy

Short-form video editing using CapCut or similar

Canva and visual content creation

Shopify

E-commerce website optimisation

Conversion optimisation

SEO and keyword research


 marketing

Influencer/UGC outreach

Analytics and performance reporting

Excellent written and spoken English is essential.



You should also have a strong visual eye and understand how to maintain a professional and consistent brand aesthetic.

Most importantly, you must be proactive, creative, organised and commercially minded.

We don't want to provide you with a detailed task list every morning.

We want someone who can look at our social media, website, competitors and performance and say:

"I've identified an opportunity. Here's what I recommend we do, why I think it could work and what I need from you to execute it."

We want someone who is comfortable bringing ideas to the founder, rather than waiting for the founder to bring every idea to them.



Working Arrangement & Salary



This is a full-time, remote and long-term position.

You will work closely with the founder but will be expected to manage your workload independently and take ownership of your areas of responsibility.

We are currently a small/start-up brand, so we're looking for someone who understands the realities of working with a growing business and is genuinely excited about helping build something.

Salary is negotiable and will depend on your experience, skills and proven results.

We are working with a start-up budget at this stage, so please include your expected monthly salary for full-time work when applying.

For the right person, there is significant opportunity for the role, responsibilities and compensation to grow alongside the business.



How to Apply

Please include the following with your application:

CV/resume and portfolio.

Links to social-media accounts, e-commerce stores or websites you have personally worked on.

IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words “ECOM GROWTH” so we know you have read the full job description.

Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will receive further information about the brand and will be invited to an interview.



Final candidates may also be asked to complete a small paid practical assessment before an offer is made.

We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of a growing business - someone who can bring ideas, take ownership, execute and help us achieve measurable growth over the long term.

title: Shopify Store Operator — AI-Driven Store (Systems-Minded, Full-Time)
description:
FIRST — PLEASE ANSWER HONESTLY: This is a full-time role, about 40–50 hours per week, working US Eastern business hours (this is a night shift in the Philippines). Can you genuinely commit to that long-term? Put YES or NO at the very top of your reply — only say yes if you truly can.



About us

We're a USA-based premium contemporary home décor brand — sculptural furniture, lighting, mirrors, and wall art. Our product pages read like a design gallery, not a discount store. We're looking for one sharp, detail-obsessed person to help us run and grow the store. You'll work US-friendly hours; we'll confirm the exact window.



What you'll do

• Operate our AI-driven store (the core). We run a custom dashboard, an AI agent system, and automation that does a lot of the work. Your job is to understand how it all fits together and run the machine — the right tool, the right step, in the right order.

• Run the AI listing pipeline. Our AI generates the product listings; you operate the workflow, push products live, and keep them flowing as new products arrive. You operate it — you don't write the copy.

• Quality-check for accuracy. Catch the factual errors that matter — wrong dimensions, wrong price, wrong product — before anything goes live.

• Own the store day to day. Handle whatever the Shopify store and storefront need; you're the go-to operator for "the store."

• Troubleshoot. When something looks off (wrong stock on the site, a product not showing, automation acting up), figure out where the problem is and drive the fix or flag it clearly.



This is NOT a copywriting job (the AI writes), NOT customer support, and NOT a basic listings job. It's a run-the-system role for someone who likes understanding how things work.



Who you are

• You're systems-minded and tech-comfortable. You enjoy learning how a complex setup works and can reason about how the pieces connect. You don't need to code — you need to "get" how things run and operate inside them. This is the most important thing.

• You use AI tools (ChatGPT / Claude) daily, know how to drive them to a good result, and can tell when the output is wrong.

• You're comfortable in Shopify (products, variants, collections, the draft-to-active flow).

• You're a troubleshooter — when something breaks, you trace it instead of guessing.

• You're adaptable — happy owning "the whole store," not just ticking off a fixed task list.

• You're meticulous about accuracy. A wrong dimension or price drives you crazy.

• Your written English is strong enough to communicate clearly. (You won't be writing product copy — the AI does that — so polished marketing writing is not required.)



What we offer

• Competitive pay with real raises as you grow.

• Full-time, long-term, stable work with one company (not juggling clients).

• 13th-month pay / year-end bonus plus performance bonuses.

• A founder who values good work and gives clear direction.



HOW TO APPLY (please read — applications that skip a step won't be reviewed)

1. Start your message with the word ATELIER so we know you actually read this post.

2. Tell us: in 2–3 sentences, describe a system, tool, or automated workflow you learned and operated — and how you used an AI tool (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your work.

3. Quick reasoning question. Imagine a store set up like this: a dashboard pushes inventory to Shopify; an AI tool drafts the product listings; nothing goes live until a person approves it. A customer reports that a product shows the wrong stock number on the website. In a few sentences: how would you figure out where the problem is? (We're not looking for a "correct" answer — we want to see how you think through a system.)



We read every application that follows these three steps. We're excited to meet you.

title: Video Editor - YouTube Long-Form + Shorts (Ongoing Monthly Retainer)
description:
We run an acquisition agency and we're scaling two YouTube channels with the same format. We need one editor who can hold a consistent standard, week in week out, on an ongoing basis. This is not a one-off gig.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



Two brands, one format, so you learn the style once and apply it to both.



16 long-form YouTube videos per month. Capped at 15 minutes, usually 10 to 12.

Up to 60 shorts per month, cut from those long-forms and from raw clips we send, formatted for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.



Expect around 13 to 15 hours a week.



Only two video types:



Lifestyle / story videos — talking head with B-roll cutaways

Technical breakdowns — screen recordings of real dashboards and numbers, composited cleanly



Same template every time. Once you've learned it, it's repeatable work.



WHAT YOU GET FROM US



A full package for every single video: the script, editing notes, and a shot list telling you exactly which B-roll clip goes where. You are never guessing what we want.

An organised Google Drive with labelled and indexed B-roll, horizontal and vertical.

Fast feedback. One revision round, not endless nitpicking.

We run AI tools for the first pass on rough cuts and captions, so the grunt work is partly done before it reaches you. Your job is polish and judgment.



PAY



Monthly retainer, paid on time, every time. No chasing, no invoicing battles.



16 long-form + up to 30 shorts = $400/month

16 long-form + up to 60 shorts = $550/month (this is where we're starting)

16 long-form + up to 90 shorts = $700/month



The long-form count is steady at 16. The shorts are what moves, so you get paid for the tier you actually deliver. We start at $550 and you move up the moment the volume does. We are not going to argue about it or make you ask twice. Payment by Wise, PayPal, or whatever works for you.



PAID TRIAL



Before any ongoing arrangement we pay $15 to $25 for one trial edit on a real video, 48 hour turnaround. We do not ask anyone to work for free.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



A reel, or 3 recent long-form videos you edited start to finish

Ability to composite screen recordings and screenshots cleanly. This is most of the technical videos, so it matters more than anything else on this list

Genuinely fast at cutting vertical shorts out of long-form. This is a big chunk of the volume, so speed here counts

First cut within 48 hours

Consistency. Available every week, ongoing



SOFTWARE: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut or CapCut. We don't mind which, we care about the output.



HOW TO APPLY



Send:



Your reel or 3 examples of long-form YouTube you cut start to finish

Your monthly rate

Your typical first-cut turnaround with your current workload

One thing you would change about a video you did not make. Any video, your choice.



That last question is the one we actually read. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

title: Operations Team Lead (Remote)
description:
Operations Team Lead(Remote) for SteelSafe Self Storage



Pay: up to $2,000 / month

Schedule: 8:00 AM–6:00 PM EST (Mon–Fri), 1 hour lunch

Work Location: Remote (Philippines)





At SteelSafe we get things get finished.

Leads don’t sit.

Follow-ups don’t disappear.

Customer problems don’t get “noted” and forgotten.



If you’re the type of manager who needs constant reminders or gives status updates without results, this won’t be a fit.



If you like building a strong team, coaching people to improve, and running a clean system where nothing falls through the cracks, keep reading.



What you’ll be doing

-You’ll manage a team of remote CSRs in the Philippines and help us build a reliable sales and service engine.

-You will also take calls. Our volume is manageable (usually around 15 calls per CSR per day). We expect you to lead by example, not just by telling people what to do.



What you’ll own (non-negotiables)

-You will make sure no rentals are missed. Every day you will check every lead source and make sure every opportunity has a real outcome.

-You will review website form submissions and confirm whether they rented. If they did not rent, you will call them, log them properly in CallPotential, and document the result and next step.

-You will review CallPotential leads and reservations daily, make sure the status is correct (Lead vs Reservation), verify outcomes, and follow up to close.

-You will review inbound sales calls and make sure non-renters are called back with a real attempt to convert, and you will document what happened.

-Every lead must end the day as one of three things: rented, didn’t rent (with the reason), or a scheduled follow-up with a specific date and time.

-You will run a real call review and coaching system. This is not “we’ll review calls when we have time.”

-The expectation is that you review sales calls daily (or meet a minimum standard if call volume spikes), and you review at least five service calls per day looking for service recovery issues.

-When calls are weak—missed close, wrong information, tone problems, or a bad customer experience—you will send short, clear coaching feedback, coach the CSR directly, and make sure the correction shows up within the next 24–48 hours.

-You will also save coaching examples into a simple training library so the whole team improves over time.

-You will handle escalations and service recovery.

-If someone is upset, did not rent because of the experience, or has a sensitive issue, you will personally follow up, fix the issue, and turn it into a win when possible.

-You will make sure escalations are actually resolved, not just “handled.”

-You will set the standard, train people, enforce quality, and hold the line. That includes hiring and training when needed, assigning tasks and expectations clearly, correcting problems quickly when performance slips, and keeping the team professional and consistent.

-A non-negotiable part of this job is “close-the-loop” control.

-You will review each CSR’s daily update. We do not accept status-only updates.

-Every item must have a result or a next step.

-Anything labeled “pending customer response” must have a follow-up plan and a scheduled date.

-If something is not confirmed complete, it must be assigned a next action with an owner and a due time.

-No dropped balls. No silent failures.



Reporting (daily + weekly)

-Each day you will post a simple daily report so leadership has clarity and the team stays sharp.

-That daily report must include: forms reviewed, leads and reservations reviewed, new rentals closed, open follow-ups, calls listened to, calls flagged, the patterns you are seeing, which CSRs missed closes, what coaching was given, unhappy customers identified and recovered, anything left open, and tomorrow’s focus.

-Each week you will produce a scorecard showing leads vs rentals and conversion percent by source (website, CallPotential, inbound calls), performance by CSR (calls, rentals, conversion percent), top wins, and the top focus areas for next week.





You’re a great fit if…

You take ownership and solve problems instead of passing them around.

You’re a real coach who is clear and helpful, but firm when needed.

You like numbers and performance tracking.

Your spoken and written English is excellent, and you’re confident on the phone.

You can lead with high standards without being toxic.



Small business reality

Random urgent things will come up sometimes. We want someone who stays calm, proposes options, makes decisions, and follows through.

This is not an executive assistant role, but it is a role for someone who solves problems.



How to apply (required)

Please send your resume, and let us know what ownership means to you!

title: Video Editor & Static Ad Designer for E-commerce (Meta & TikTok) — Path to Creative Strategist
description:
We are a fast-growing multi-brand e-commerce company. We produce a high

volume of ad creatives every week and we are looking for a video editor

and static ad designer to join our team long-term.



This is NOT regular video editing. This is direct-response ad editing.

Every second counts, every cut has a purpose, and the work is measured

in data: hook rate, hold rate, CTR, conversions.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Edit ads for Meta and TikTok: UGC, mashups, VSLs, before/after,

  testimonials, split screens

- Build visual hooks that stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds

- Structure every edit around the psychological journey:

  Hook > Pain > Solution > Mechanism > CTA

- Control cut rhythm, dynamic subtitles, zooms, transitions and

  retention effects

- Design static ads for Meta: image ads, before/after visuals, review

  and testimonial graphics, comparison charts, offer and pricing

  visuals

- Source or generate your own b-roll. We do not send you footage.

- Produce several DIFFERENT concepts from the same product and the

  same script, not three versions of the same edit

- Iterate fast on winning creatives based on performance data

- Adapt every creative to all formats and placements: Reels, Stories,

  Feed, TikTok

- Deliver volume, several creatives per day, without dropping quality



THE FORMATS WE TEST



We test what is working this month, not what worked last year. You need

to be able to build all of these:



- UGC and mashups with real footage

- VSLs, before/after, testimonials, split screens

- Pixar-style and 3D animated ads

- Cartoon and anime-style ads

- AI song ads and jingle-driven creatives

- AI avatars and faceless formats

- ASMR and satisfying-loop creatives

- Product mechanism animation: everything that cannot be filmed



If you can only do UGC mashups, this is not for you.



Part of your job is telling us what you see trending before we ask.



ABOUT AI - READ THIS CAREFULLY



You generate your own assets. We do not send you footage.



- B-roll: Sora, Kling, Veo, Seedance, Runway or equivalent

- Images: Midjourney, Nano Banana, Flux or equivalent

- Voice: ElevenLabs or equivalent

- Music and song: Suno, Udio or equivalent



One rule: real footage wins whenever the shot should look real. AI is

for the concept formats and for everything that cannot be filmed. An

AI-generated person pretending to be a real customer is the fastest way

to kill an ad, and we expect you to know the difference.



If your answer to every creative problem is "I'll generate it", this is

not the right fit.



ABOUT LANGUAGE - READ THIS CAREFULLY



Our main market is FRANCE. We also run ads in Italian, Spanish and

English.



You do NOT need to speak French. Speaking it is a bonus, not a

requirement.



What IS required: you must be able to use AI tools (voice generation,

subtitles, translation) and deliver output that is FLAWLESS in a

language you do not speak. No robotic voice. No wrong subtitle timing.

No broken accents or missing characters. No AI artifacts.



If you have never had to guarantee quality in a language you don't

speak, this role is not for you.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Minimum 2 years editing e-commerce video ads

- Proven work on Meta and/or TikTok ads (portfolio required)

- Strong with CapCut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

- Comfortable designing static ad creatives, not just video

  (Photoshop, Canva or Figma)

- Real command of AI generation for video, image, voice and music

- You can propose several distinct creative angles for the same

  product. Concept variety matters more here than polish.

- You follow trends closely and can name what is working right now

- You understand direct-response marketing: AIDA, hook rate, hold rate,

  and why an ad works or fails

- Conversational English is enough

- Independent, fast, detail-obsessed, reliable

- You take feedback and iterate without ego



WHERE THIS LEADS



We are not looking for someone to just execute a brief. We want someone

who understands the marketing behind the creative and wants to grow into

creative strategy: choosing the angles, writing the concepts, d

what we test next.



If that is the direction you want for your career, tell us in your

application.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Full-time freelance contract, 40 hours per week, stable and long-term

- Competitive pay that grows with your results

- Performance bonuses on winning ads

- Ongoing training on creative trends and advertising frameworks

- A real path from editor to creative strategist



HOW TO APPLY



1. Send your portfolio with e-commerce ad examples. Include both video

   ads and static ads. Applications without a portfolio will not be

   reviewed.

2. Send me ONE fully AI-generated or animated ad you made. Tell me

   which tools you used and why you chose that format for that

   product.

3. Answer these two questions in your message:

   - Pick one ad in your portfolio and tell us why it performed.

     Not what you did. Why it worked.

   - You have to deliver a French ad and you don't speak French.

     Walk us through your exact process to make sure the voiceover

     and the subtitles are perfect.

4. Start your message with the word "HOOK" so we know you read this

   post to the end.



Best,

VENP

title: Customer Service Respresentative
description:
We’re looking for a Customer Service Representative who will take full responsibility for handling customer inquiries, exchanges, and returns for our E-commerce fashion dropshipping stores.

You’ll be part of a dedicated customer service team, working closely with other representatives and a manager to ensure that as much revenue as possible is driven and retained through customer service.



We’re not looking for someone who just “replies to emails.” We’re looking for someone who thinks and acts like an A-player: disciplined, proactive, and committed to excellence.

You communicate with empathy, and take ownership of every situation. You always look for solutions instead of excuses and understand that every interaction is a chance to create value for both the customer and the company.



You must already have experience in customer service for Shopify fashion dropshipping stores, and know how to communicate effectively, handle returns and exchanges, and solve problems efficiently, keeping customers happy while protecting company profits.

You should know how to use Shopify and ParcelPanel, maintain a professional and calm tone under pressure, and be able to work according to the New York (US) timezone, since most of our customer interactions follow that schedule.

Experience with return funnels and ChatGPT for communication improvement is a must.



You’ll handle emails, refunds, replacements, and order inquiries together with other team members, ensuring a fast, professional, and solution-oriented customer experience every day.

We value people who are organized, reliable, and detail-oriented, who identify problems before they escalate, and who constantly aim to improve how things are done.



You understand that great customer service doesn’t just solve issues. It drives revenue and keeps profits within the company.



This is a position for someone who takes pride in delivering world-class service and wants to be part of a high-performing, professional team.



Please answer these questions in your application:

1. What is your experience with customer service for Shopify fashion dropshipping stores, and for how long?

2. Have you worked for other fashion dropshipping stores before? If yes, which ones?

3. What are your main strengths, and how can you make the company better? What knowledge or ideas can you bring?

4. Are you familiar with Shopify, Commslayer, ParcelPanel, and ChatGPT?

5. Do you have experience with return funnels?

6. Do you speak and write English fluently?

7. Are you currently working for another company?

8. How many hours and days per week are you available? Are you also available during weekends?

9. Can you work according to the New York (US) timezone?

10. Do you always have a stable Wi-Fi connection?

11. What is your desired monthly compensation?

12. What’s your favorite dish?



Please include your phone number in the application so we can contact you directly through Whatsapp!

title: Part-Time Virtual Assistant — Business & Family Support
description:
Part-Time Virtual Assistant — Business & Family Support



Company: Da' Roofers (residential roofing company, Bethesda, MD area, USA) Job type: Part-time, ongoing Hours: ~10 hours/week, flexible schedule (Philippine time is fine — most work can be done async) Pay: $200/month, paid via Wise



About the role



I'm the co-owner of a small residential roofing company, and I'm looking for a reliable, detail-oriented virtual assistant to take a mix of small recurring tasks off my plate — some for the business, some for my household and family of three kids. This is a generalist support role, not a specialized one: the right person is organized, communicates clearly in English, and doesn't need much hand-holding once a task is explained.



I'll be honest that I don't have every task mapped out yet — this role will evolve as we go, and I'm looking for someone who's genuinely flexible about that: comfortable picking up new types of tasks, asking good clarifying questions, and even noticing things I should be staying on top of before I ask. Someone who helps me stay ahead of the game, not just checks off a fixed list.



You won't be doing anything in person — everything is remote:
, phone/text follow-ups, online research, scheduling, and light data entry.



What you'll help with



Business admin (Da' Roofers)



Managing my inbox: sorting, flagging, drafting routine replies

Keeping my calendar updated and scheduling appointments

Following up with customers/leads by phone or text (reminders, rescheduling, simple check-ins)

Data entry into our company reference sheet (contacts, license/insurance renewal dates, supplier info, etc.)



Household & family admin



Keeping our family calendar updated (appointments, activities, school events)

Researching and helping book services for the house (contractors, deliveries, providers)

Family meal planning and grocery ordering

Handling school/activity logistics for our 3 kids — forms, sign-ups, reminders, deadlines

Researching and helping plan family trips and events (birthdays, etc.)



Task mix will vary week to week — some weeks will lean more toward business, others toward family logistics.



What I'm looking for

Flexible and adaptable — this role isn't a fixed checklist; the tasks will shift and expand over time, and I need someone comfortable with that kind of ambiguity, not someone who needs a rigid job description to function

Proactive — comfortable flagging things I might be missing and suggesting better ways to stay organized, not just waiting to be told what to do

Strong written and spoken English

Comfortable making outbound calls/texts to US customers

Good with Google Calendar/Gmail (or willing to learn quickly)

Organized, and good about following up on open items without being reminded

Trustworthy with personal/family information and comfortable with a light, varying task list

Own reliable internet and a quiet space for occasional calls



Nice to have (not required): prior experience as a VA for a small business owner or a family; experience with a small home-services or contracting business; experience in a role where your responsibilities changed or grew over time.



How to apply



A short intro (2-3 sentences) about your VA experience

Include the word "sunrise" somewhere in your application — this lets me know you read the full post

A 1-2 minute self-introduction video (screen recording or just you talking) so I can hear your English and get a sense of how you communicate

Your availability (days/hours) for ~10 hrs/week, and confirmation you're comfortable with the pay listed above



Applications that skip these steps won't be considered — I'm looking for someone detail-oriented from the start. Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: # Google Ads, SEO & Lead Generation Specialist — Full-Time Remote
description:
# Google Ads, SEO & Lead Generation Specialist — Full-Time Remote



**Salary: $700–$900 USD/month + 3%–5% Commission**

**Payment: Every 2 Weeks — No Upfront Payment**

**Long-Term Remote Position**



We are a **U.S.-based insulation company** looking for an experienced **Google Ads, SEO & Lead Generation Specialist** to manage our digital marketing and generate qualified local leads.



Experience with **construction, insulation, home improvement, HVAC, roofing, or other U.S. local-service businesses is a major plus.**



## REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



* **5+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience — REQUIRED**

* **5+ years of SEO and Local SEO experience — REQUIRED**

* **3+ years of proven experience generating qualified leads — REQUIRED**

* Strong experience with Google Search and Performance Max

* Google Ads conversion tracking

* Google Analytics & Google Tag Manager

* Google Business Profile optimization

* WordPress/Elementor experience

* Landing-page creation and optimization

* Strong understanding of keywords, negative keywords, search terms, bidding, budgets, and campaign optimization

* Strong English communication



**This is NOT an entry-level position.** You must be able to independently manage the work without requiring training.



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Create, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns

* Generate qualified local leads

* Manage Search and Performance Max campaigns

* Monitor keywords, search terms, negative keywords, budgets, and conversions

* Manage SEO and Local SEO

* Optimize Google Business Profile

* Manage conversion tracking, Google Analytics, and Google Tag Manager

* Make SEO and marketing changes directly to our WordPress/Elementor website

* Create and improve landing pages

* Monitor lead quality and campaign performance

* Identify problems and implement solutions



## COMMUNICATION & WORK HOURS



**Reliable communication is mandatory.**



* Must be able to **communicate through WhatsApp**

* Must be able to **work U.S. business hours**

* Must be responsive during working hours

* Must communicate problems or delays immediately

* Must notify us before a deadline if something cannot be completed on time



We do not micromanage, but we expect professional and consistent communication.



**We should not have to repeatedly contact you for updates.**



## COMPENSATION



**$700–$900 USD per month**, depending on experience and qualifications.



Payment is made **every two weeks for work already completed.**



**NO UPFRONT PAYMENT.** We do not pay a full month in advance or provide salary advances.



### 3%–5% COMMISSION AFTER FIRST MONTH



After successfully completing your first month, you will be eligible for an additional **3%–5% commission on completed sales generated from qualified leads produced through the marketing you manage.**



Commission is paid **in addition to your regular monthly salary.**



## HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this position:



**1. Upload your Resume/CV through the job portal — PDF required.**



**2. Upload your portfolio if available — PDF preferred.**



**3. Also
 your Resume/CV and portfolio to:**





Your resume should clearly show your Google Ads, SEO/Local SEO, and lead-generation experience.



Your portfolio should include examples of actual work and results when available, such as:



* Google Ads campaigns and results

* Leads/conversions and cost per lead

* SEO/Local SEO results

* Ranking improvements

* Lead-generation results

* Construction or home-service marketing experience



Please attach your resume and portfolio as files rather than sending multiple individual screenshots whenever possible.



### Please also include:



* Years of hands-on Google Ads experience

* Years of SEO/Local SEO experience

* Years of lead-generation experience

* Construction or U.S. local-service marketing experience

* Country/time zone

* Confirmation that you can **work U.S. business hours**

* Confirmation that you can **communicate through WhatsApp**

* Expected monthly salary



**If you do not meet the required experience or cannot work U.S. business hours, please do not apply.**

 address

title: Linkedin GhostWriter + Outreach (Copywriters welcome to apply)
description:
We are looking for a strong writer, clear thinker and creative communicator to join our team and support our LinkedIn marketing work.



We work with business owners and professionals to help them build their authority on LinkedIn, create engaging content, grow their networks and turn relationships into genuine business opportunities.



This is a varied role combining:



- LinkedIn content writing

- Story-based copywriting

- LinkedIn graphic creation

-
 relationship building and follow-up

- LinkedIn outreach and conversations



You do not need to already be a LinkedIn expert.



Training will be provided on our LinkedIn strategy, content frameworks, storytelling approach and conversation/outreach processes.



However, you must already be a strong writer with the ability to understand information quickly and communicate it clearly.



We are particularly interested in someone who can take a complicated subject and make it feel simple.



An engineering, technical, analytical or other structured-thinking background would be a strong advantage.



1. LinkedIn Content Writing



A major part of your role will be writing LinkedIn content for different businesses and professionals.



You may be given:



- Interview or meeting transcripts

- Voice notes

- Client stories

- Business information

- Rough ideas and notes

- Videos or podcasts

- Existing marketing material



Your job is not simply to summarise this information.



You need to be able to understand the material, identify what is interesting and turn it into a strong LinkedIn post.



We are particularly interested in story-based business writing.



You should naturally think about questions such as:



- What is the story here?

- What makes this interesting?

- Why would the reader care?

- What is the business insight?

- How can I explain this simply?

- How can I make this sound like the person I'm writing for?



We are NOT looking for generic content that follows the same "hook + three tips + CTA" formula every time.



The writing should feel human, specific and interesting.



You will receive training in our LinkedIn content methodology, but strong writing ability is essential before you start.



2. Creating LinkedIn Graphics



Creating graphics is a regular and important part of this role.



You will be responsible for creating the visual content that accompanies LinkedIn posts.



This may include:



- Single-image LinkedIn graphics

- Quote or statement graphics

- Simple branded graphics

- Simple diagrams

- Thumbnail-style graphics



You should be comfortable using Canva or similar design software.



You do not need to be an advanced graphic designer.



In fact, we generally prefer simple designs.



What matters is that you have good visual judgement and can understand the main message of a post and communicate that idea visually without making the design cluttered or complicated.



Experience creating LinkedIn graphics or YouTube thumbnails would be a strong advantage.



3. Relationship-Building
s



You will also help us reconnect with people with whom we already have business relationships.



You may be given access to previous
 conversations and asked to understand:



- Who the person is

- What they do

- How we know them

- What we previously discussed

- Where the relationship or conversation stopped

- What opportunities may exist to reconnect

- What would be a genuine reason to contact them again



You will then draft a personalised
 to restart the conversation.



This is not mass
 marketing.



We don't want generic templates being sent to hundreds of people.



You need to be able to read previous conversations, understand context and write something that feels natural, personal and relevant to that particular relationship.



4. LinkedIn Outreach & Conversations



Another part of the role will be helping us build relationships through LinkedIn.



This may include:



- Identifying relevant people to connect with

- Sending personalised connection messages

- Starting conversations

- Responding to messages

- Following up naturally

- Maintaining conversations over time

- Recognising potential business opportunities

- Helping move appropriate conversations towards a call



We will provide training on our approach. The goal is to have genuine conversations that build trust and relationships.



Previous experience in sales, business development, appointment setting, lead generation, customer service or LinkedIn outreach would therefore be an advantage.



Who We Are Looking For



The most important qualities for this role are writing ability, comprehension and clear thinking.



You should be someone who can receive a lot of information, understand what actually matters and communicate it simply.



You should:



- Be an excellent written English communicator

- Write naturally and conversationally

- Understand storytelling

- Be able to identify a good story from raw information

- Understand complicated ideas and simplify them

- Be curious and willing to research unfamiliar subjects

- Have strong attention to detail

- Be able to understand different businesses relatively quickly

- Be able to write in different people's voices

- Have good visual judgement

- Be comfortable creating graphics in Canva or similar tools

- Be comfortable communicating with people online

- Be open to feedback and training

- Be organised and able to manage multiple pieces of content



We would particularly value someone with an analytical, engineering, technical, scientific, financial or similarly structured-thinking background.



Your ability to understand complex subjects is important.



LinkedIn Experience



Previous LinkedIn experience is a big advantage, but it is not essential.



If you have previously:



- Written LinkedIn posts

- Ghostwritten for founders or business owners

- Managed LinkedIn accounts

- Created LinkedIn graphics

- Created LinkedIn carousels

- Conducted LinkedIn outreach

- Managed LinkedIn conversations



Please include examples when you apply.



However, if you haven't worked specifically with LinkedIn but you are an exceptional writer with strong business comprehension, we would still like to hear from you.



What We Will Teach You



We will provide training and examples to help you understand:



- How we write LinkedIn content

- How we identify stories

- How we structure different types of LinkedIn posts

- How we write in a client's voice

- How we create LinkedIn graphics

- How we build professional networks

- How we start conversations

- How we follow up without being pushy

- How we move appropriate conversations towards business calls



We are not expecting someone to arrive knowing our entire process.



We are looking for someone with the underlying ability to become excellent at it.



How to Apply



Please do not send only a CV or a generic application.



We want to see how you think and communicate.



Please include the following with your application:



1. Writing Samples



Send us 2–3 examples of your best writing.



We would particularly like to see business writing that tells a story rather than purely promotional copy.



LinkedIn posts are ideal, but articles,
s, scripts, social media posts or other business content are also welcome.



2. Simplifying a Complex Subject



Please show us one example where you took something relatively complicated and explained it in a simple, easy-to-understand way.



This is particularly important to us.



3. Design Samples



Please include examples of graphics you have personally created.



These could include:



LinkedIn graphics

Carousels

Social media graphics

YouTube thumbnails

Infographics

Other simple business content



Please tell us which parts you personally created.



4. LinkedIn Experience



If you have written LinkedIn posts or managed LinkedIn accounts before, please send us links, screenshots or samples.



If you haven't, that's okay. Just tell us that you haven't.



5. Sales / Outreach Experience



Briefly tell us about any experience you've had with:



Sales

Business development

LinkedIn outreach

Lead generation

Appointment setting

Customer conversations



Again, this is an advantage rather than an absolute requirement.



6. Tell Us About You



In a few sentences, tell us:



What is your background, and why do you think you would be particularly good at understanding complex businesses and turning their ideas into simple, interesting content?



7. Availability and Hours



How many hours are you wanting to work per week? And, what's your expected monthly rate?



One Final Note



Please don't worry if you don't meet every requirement listed above.



We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already spent years as a "LinkedIn specialist."



We are looking for someone who has the foundations we can build on:



Strong writing.

Clear thinking.

Storytelling ability.

Curiosity.

Good visual judgement.

Attention to detail.

And the ability to communicate naturally with people.



If you have those qualities, we can teach you the rest.
